dialogues.title: 姓名、职责和可用联系路径
dialogues.premise: 接班复述正确，验证轮值、供应商入口与升级备选。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分内部决策人、供应商跟进人和备班。

lines.en: Okay, the duty contact list is current. Lukas is primary on-call from this point.
lines.zh: 好，值班联系人表已更新，从现在起Lukas是主值班。

lines.en: I can open the roster and incident record. Who approves any wider routing change?
lines.zh: 我能打开轮值表和事件记录。谁批准更大范围路由变化？

lines.en: The rostered incident coordinator owns that decision. Their paging alias is tested and recorded.
lines.zh: 轮值故障协调人负责该决策，呼叫别名已验证并记录。

lines.en: I'm on it for carrier communications. Ticket access works, but phone escalation needs verification.
lines.zh: 运营商沟通我来负责。工单访问可用，电话升级还要验证。

lines.en: Raj verified the contracted support number earlier. Use the authenticated account reference in storage.
lines.zh: Raj之前验证了合同支持号码，使用受控存储里的认证账号参考信息。

lines.en: Just to confirm, secrets stay out of chat, right? Contact references don't need copied credentials.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，秘密信息不进聊天，对吧？联系记录不需要复制凭据。

lines.en: Agreed, and if I don't respond promptly? Who receives the backup page tonight?
lines.zh: 同意。如果我没及时回应，今晚备班呼叫发给谁？

lines.en: The roster routes it to the backup SRE. Page the backup after about five minutes.
lines.zh: 轮值表会路由到备班SRE，大约五分钟后呼叫备班。

lines.en: The escalation path opens from my account too. We won't depend on an outgoing engineer.
lines.zh: 我的账号也能打开升级路径，不依赖已经下班的工程师。

lines.en: So, contact access is now confirmed. Raj remains available until final acceptance only.
lines.zh: 因此联系权限现在已确认。Raj只在最终接受前继续待命。

dialogues.scene: 接班复述正确，验证轮值、供应商入口与升级备选。
dialogues.dir: network/0104-姓名、职责和可用联系路径
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 接手确认和下一次更新
dialogues.premise: 技术边界与联系人均确认，明确21:00更新与提前触发条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 复述接班负责内容和无新证据时也必须更新的承诺。

lines.en: Just to recap, the next update is nine. That's local time on the incident record.
lines.zh: 小结一下，下次更新九点，按事件记录上的本地时区。

lines.en: I've got it from here on coordination. Two workers remain rerouted; primary diagnosis stays open.
lines.zh: 协调从这里我接手。两个工作进程维持绕行，主线诊断尚未结束。

lines.en: Okay, the mitigation is holding for those workers. Saved configurations and evidence references are attached.
lines.zh: 好，这些工作进程缓解仍有效。已附保存配置和证据引用。

lines.en: I'll request the carrier's pending diagnostic update. No reply still becomes an explicit status.
lines.zh: 我会索取运营商尚未给出的诊断更新。未回复也会明确报状态。

lines.en: I'll monitor reconciliation and both client groups. Any correctness issue gets an immediate page.
lines.zh: 我监控核对和两类客户端。任何正确性问题立即呼叫。

lines.en: Just to confirm, threshold breaches update earlier, right? Don't wait for the scheduled nine.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，超过门槛要提前更新，对吧？不等计划九点。

lines.en: Correct, and routing changes need capacity assessment. We won't automatically restore the primary path.
lines.zh: 对，路由变化需评估容量，不自动恢复主路径。

lines.en: If asked what's the ETA, distinguish diagnosis. We still have no repair estimate.
lines.zh: 被问预计多久时要区分诊断，目前仍没有修复时间估计。

lines.en: Understood, ticket evidence before any recovery claim. Quiet probes alone won't close this incident.
lines.zh: 明白，宣称恢复前需要工单证据。探测平静不能单独关闭事件。

lines.en: So, handoff accepted at roughly eight forty-five. Update at nine even without new findings.
lines.zh: 因此大约八点四十五接受交接。即使没有新发现，九点也更新。

dialogues.scene: 技术边界与联系人均确认，明确21:00更新与提前触发条件。
dialogues.dir: network/0105-接手确认和下一次更新
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 先对齐本周交付
dialogues.premise: 周一09:00站会开场，明确自动化交付和会议时间边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清试点准备与生产扩展不是同一项承诺。

lines.en: Okay, our weekly priority is safer automation. Patch evidence, rotation checks, and service limits.
lines.zh: 好，本周优先事项是更安全的自动化：补丁证据、轮转检查和服务上限。

lines.en: Does safer mean broader rollout this week? I'd separate review readiness from production expansion.
lines.zh: 更安全意味着本周扩大上线吗？我会把可评审和生产扩展分开。

lines.en: Agreed, evidence first, then approved pilot expansion. We aren't promising the whole fleet yet.
lines.zh: 同意，先有证据，再批准扩大试点，尚不承诺整个集群。

lines.en: I have a hard stop at nine fifteen. Please keep detailed debugging outside this standup.
lines.zh: 我九点十五必须结束，详细调试请留到站会外。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for service validation today. Roughly half my morning is available.
lines.zh: 今天我有精力做服务验证，大约半个上午有空。

lines.en: Just to confirm, progress and dependencies first, right? Each action item needs a clear owner.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，先讲进展和依赖，对吧？每项待办都要明确负责人。

lines.en: Yes, and name anything needing my review. I can reserve an afternoon slot.
lines.zh: 对，也说清哪些需要我评审。我可以留下午时段。

lines.en: I have Friday's pilot evidence ready. The larger rollout still needs application approval.
lines.zh: 我已备好周五试点证据，更大范围上线仍需应用批准。

lines.en: I'll report tests already completed on Friday. We won't run experiments during this call.
lines.zh: 我报告周五已完成的测试，不在这次会议里做试验。

lines.en: Dashboard redesign? Let's park that for now. So, start with the patch progress.
lines.zh: 仪表盘重设计先放一边。先讲补丁进展。

dialogues.scene: 周一09:00站会开场，明确自动化交付和会议时间边界。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 清单完成，扩展仍待批准
dialogues.premise: 本周以证据和审批为先，Raj报告补丁自动化进度。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分辨清单生成、试点成功和生产扩展批准。

lines.en: Okay, the patch inventory is generated automatically. Friday's two pilot hosts passed validation.
lines.zh: 好，补丁清单已自动生成，周五两台试点主机验证通过。

lines.en: Does the inventory show reboot requirements too? Package installation alone doesn't establish running kernel state.
lines.zh: 清单也显示重启需求吗？安装软件包不代表运行内核状态已更新。

lines.en: Yes, installed and running versions appear separately. A pending reboot stays clearly flagged.
lines.zh: 是，安装版本和运行版本分开显示，待重启状态明确标记。

lines.en: Did each pilot include a smoke test? Include service readiness after the reboot.
lines.zh: 每台试点都做了冒烟测试吗？也要包括重启后的服务就绪。

lines.en: Yes, both service checks passed on Friday. No remaining issue from those pilot hosts.
lines.zh: 是，两台服务检查周五都通过了，没有遗留问题。

lines.en: Just to confirm, staged rollout still applies, right? Two hosts don't prove fleet-wide compatibility.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，仍然分阶段发布，对吧？两台不能证明全量兼容。

lines.en: Correct, driver variants still need coverage. Which maintenance window covers the next group?
lines.zh: 对，驱动差异还要覆盖。下一组安排在哪个维护窗口？

lines.en: Wednesday evening, subject to the pending approval. What's the ETA from the application owner?
lines.zh: 暂定周三晚，等待批准。应用负责人预计多久回复？

lines.en: They haven't committed to an approval time. Show that dependency instead of assuming Wednesday.
lines.zh: 他们尚未承诺批准时间，应展示依赖而非假定周三执行。

lines.en: So, prepare roughly ten candidate hosts today. Don't schedule reboots before that approval lands.
lines.zh: 因此今天准备约十台候选主机，批准到位前不安排重启。

dialogues.scene: 本周以证据和审批为先，Raj报告补丁自动化进度。
dialogues.dir: linux/0107-清单完成，扩展仍待批准
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 轮转成功，也要确认重新打开日志
dialogues.premise: 补丁下一批待批准，转到日志轮转自动化进度。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清轮转文件与进程重新打开日志的区别。

lines.en: Okay, Friday's rotation test passed in staging. The service kept writing after rotation.
lines.zh: 好，周五预生产轮转测试通过，服务轮转后继续写入。

lines.en: Did it reopen the log correctly? A renamed file can remain open indefinitely.
lines.zh: 它正确重新打开日志了吗？重命名的文件可能一直保持打开。

lines.en: Yes, the documented reload reopens its descriptor. We confirmed writes reached the new file.
lines.zh: 是，文档中的重载会重新打开描述符，已确认写入新文件。

lines.en: Is that behavior specific to this service? Don't assume every daemon handles reload identically.
lines.zh: 这种行为是这个服务特有的吗？不能假定所有守护进程重载行为相同。

lines.en: Yes, the automation selects a service-specific handler. Unknown services stop for manual review.
lines.zh: 是，自动化选择服务专属处理器，未知服务停止并人工评审。

lines.en: Just to confirm, retention policy stays unchanged, right? This task doesn't authorize extra deletion.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，保留策略不变，对吧？这项任务不授权额外删除。

lines.en: Correct, test files only in staging. I'll compare the configured retention with actual outputs.
lines.zh: 对，预生产只用测试文件。我会比较配置保留策略和实际输出。

lines.en: Let me tail the log after standup. That will supply today's verification evidence.
lines.zh: 站会后我会盯日志，补上今天验证证据。

lines.en: And before you rotate the log again, save the test state. Keep results reproducible.
lines.zh: 再次轮转前保存测试状态，让结果可复现。

lines.en: So, roughly one hour for evidence cleanup. We can review without changing production today.
lines.zh: 因此大约一小时整理证据。今天不改生产也能评审。

dialogues.scene: 补丁下一批待批准，转到日志轮转自动化进度。
dialogues.dir: linux/0108-轮转成功，也要确认重新打开日志
dialogues.audio: 0108-轮转成功，也要确认重新打开日志.mp3
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 服务上限不能只看登录Shell
dialogues.premise: 轮转证据需整理，Anika继续报告服务文件描述符上限试点。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分Shell设置、systemd配置和进程实际生效值。

lines.en: Okay, the file descriptor limit pilot passed. Two staging workers now have higher limits.
lines.zh: 好，文件描述符上限试点通过，两台预生产工作进程上限已提高。

lines.en: Did you change the shell ulimit only? Systemd services inherit their own configured limits.
lines.zh: 只修改了Shell的ulimit吗？systemd服务使用自己的配置上限。

lines.en: No, managed configuration sets the service limit. We checked the running process after restart.
lines.zh: 不是，受管配置设置服务上限，重启后检查了运行进程。

lines.en: Was the kernel-wide file table checked too? A higher per-process cap isn't free capacity.
lines.zh: 也检查了内核级文件表吗？提高单进程限制不意味着新增免费容量。

lines.en: Yes, and memory headroom stayed healthy. The test also bounded connection counts explicitly.
lines.zh: 是，内存余量正常，测试也明确限制连接数量。

lines.en: Just to confirm, production unchanged, right? Increasing limits doesn't fix a descriptor leak.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，生产没变，对吧？提高上限不能修复描述符泄漏。

lines.en: Correct, document the rollback trigger separately. Restore the saved service configuration if checks fail.
lines.zh: 对，单独写明回退条件，检查失败就恢复保存的服务配置。

lines.en: And a restart needs its approved window. Roughly five minutes per worker in staging.
lines.zh: 重启还要有批准的窗口，预生产每个工作进程大约五分钟。

lines.en: Don't copy that timing straight into production. Workload and draining behavior may differ there.
lines.zh: 不要直接把这个时间用于生产，负载和排空行为可能不同。

lines.en: So, production sizing? Let's park that. Today we finish the pilot evidence first.
lines.zh: 因此生产规模配置先搁置，今天先完成试点证据。

dialogues.scene: 轮转证据需整理，Anika继续报告服务文件描述符上限试点。
dialogues.dir: linux/0109-服务上限不能只看登录Shell
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 成功路径通过，异常路径待补
dialogues.premise: 补丁、轮转和上限试点均有结果，Hannah报告自动化测试覆盖缺口。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分清已通过的测试和今日计划补充的测试。

lines.en: Our test fixture covers successful rotation already. Permission failures still need an explicit case.
lines.zh: 测试预置环境已覆盖成功轮转，权限失败还需要明确用例。

lines.en: Okay, I'll add a denied-write scenario today. The runner must stop without deleting logs.
lines.zh: 好，我今天添加禁止写入场景。执行器必须停止且不删除日志。

lines.en: What about deleted but still open files? Disk usage can differ from directory totals.
lines.zh: 已删除但仍打开的文件呢？磁盘使用可能不同于目录总量。

lines.en: That case belongs in the diagnostics test. No cleanup of open descriptors by default.
lines.zh: 这个场景属于诊断测试，默认不清理仍打开的描述符。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no production fault injection, right? Test failures stay inside isolated environments.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不在生产注入故障，对吧？失败测试留在隔离环境。

lines.en: Right, and repeated runs should be idempotent. The second run must not restart healthy services.
lines.zh: 对，多次运行应幂等，第二次不能重启健康服务。

lines.en: We'll dry-run it first for intended changes. Restart count should remain unchanged on repeats.
lines.zh: 先预演计划变更，重复运行时重启计数应不变。

lines.en: Capture both expected and actual changes. A successful exit alone won't establish safety.
lines.zh: 记录预期和实际变化，仅退出成功不能证明安全。

lines.en: My action item is the descriptor case. It should take roughly an hour today.
lines.zh: 我的待办是描述符场景，今天大约需要一小时。

lines.en: So, report coverage gaps alongside passing tests. We'll discuss implementation after this short standup.
lines.zh: 因此报告通过测试时也报告覆盖缺口。实现细节留到短站会后讨论。

dialogues.scene: 补丁、轮转和上限试点均有结果，Hannah报告自动化测试覆盖缺口。

dialogues.title: 明确请求，不临场审代码
dialogues.premise: 测试缺口已列为今日任务，明确Lukas的评审对象和时间。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出评审请求包含哪些证据以及为什么拆开变更。

lines.en: Okay, the rotation change is up for review. I've attached Friday's logs and test results.
lines.zh: 好，轮转变更等待评审，已附周五日志和测试结果。

lines.en: Do you need approval or initial feedback? Missing permission tests may block final approval.
lines.zh: 你需要批准还是初步反馈？缺权限测试可能阻止最终批准。

lines.en: Initial feedback first, then approval after tests. Do you have bandwidth this afternoon?
lines.zh: 先初步反馈，测试后再批准。你今天下午有精力吗？

lines.en: I'll link new tests when they finish. Don't describe pending coverage as already passing.
lines.zh: 新测试完成后我会附链接，不能把待补覆盖说成已通过。

lines.en: My service limit change stays separate. Different rollback paths deserve separate review requests.
lines.zh: 我的服务上限变更单独保留，不同回退路径应分开提评审。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not one combined approval, right? Who's picking this up for review?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不合并批准，对吧？谁来接评审？

lines.en: I'm on it at about two today. I'll start with rotation and its safety checks.
lines.zh: 我今天大约两点来做，先看轮转及安全检查。

lines.en: Great, expected changes are listed explicitly. The live service rollout is outside this request.
lines.zh: 好，已明确列出预期变化，真实服务上线不在这次请求内。

lines.en: Can we take it offline for code details? We still need the dependency updates here.
lines.zh: 代码细节会后单独聊好吗？这里还要更新依赖。

lines.en: So, yes, pair after the standup. For now, review ownership and scope are clear.
lines.zh: 可以，站会后结对讨论。目前评审负责人和范围已经明确。

dialogues.scene: 测试缺口已列为今日任务，明确Lukas的评审对象和时间。
dialogues.dir: linux/0111-明确请求，不临场审代码
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 哪些任务真正被阻塞
dialogues.premise: 下午评审已安排，区分生产批准与新测试环境这两项外部依赖。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清被阻塞任务和仍可推进任务的边界。

lines.en: Okay, production expansion is blocked on approval. The application team hasn't confirmed its window.
lines.zh: 好，生产扩展被审批阻塞，应用团队尚未确认窗口。

lines.en: My driver coverage needs another test image. The current image lacks that hardware variant.
lines.zh: 我的驱动覆盖需要另一个测试镜像，当前镜像没有那种硬件配置。

lines.en: Those are two different dependencies, then. Existing rotation tests can still run today.
lines.zh: 那么这是两个不同依赖，已有轮转测试今天仍能运行。

lines.en: What's the ETA for the image? Is there a named owner for delivery?
lines.zh: 镜像预计多久到？有没有明确的交付负责人？

lines.en: The platform owner expects it tomorrow morning. That's an estimate, not an approved commitment.
lines.zh: 平台负责人预计明早提供，这只是估计，不是已批准承诺。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no bypassing approval, right? The escalation path is a scheduling request.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不绕过审批，对吧？升级路径是请求协调排期。

lines.en: Correct, no borrowed production host for tests. I'll use the approved image when available.
lines.zh: 对，不借生产主机做测试，获准镜像到位后再用。

lines.en: I'm on it for the owner follow-up. Roughly noon today for a clearer update.
lines.zh: 负责人跟进我来做，今天中午左右给更明确更新。

lines.en: Then keep blocked work visibly separate. Don't mark the entire automation project as blocked.
lines.zh: 那就明确分开受阻工作，不能把整个自动化项目都标为阻塞。

lines.en: So, broad rollout? Let's park that. We can reorder the remaining work now.
lines.zh: 因此大范围上线先搁置，现在可以重排其余工作。

dialogues.scene: 下午评审已安排，区分生产批准与新测试环境这两项外部依赖。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 转向证据，不隐性扩大范围
dialogues.premise: 生产扩展和驱动镜像受阻，重新分配今天可执行的任务。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清任务重排保留哪些范围和验收责任。

lines.en: Okay, let's reassign the task for evidence cleanup. Raj can help while approval is pending.
lines.zh: 好，重新分配证据整理任务。等批准期间Raj可以帮忙。

lines.en: Which task moves, and who accepts it? Avoid leaving test ownership unclear after reassignment.
lines.zh: 哪项任务转移，谁接受？不能重分配后让测试责任不清。

lines.en: I'm on it for rotation evidence cleanup. Hannah still owns test acceptance and coverage.
lines.zh: 轮转证据整理我来做，Hannah仍负责测试验收和覆盖。

lines.en: Accepted, that gives me bandwidth for assertions. My driver tests remain pending the image.
lines.zh: 接受，这样我有精力补断言。驱动测试仍等待镜像。

lines.en: I'll keep the service limit report today. It doesn't depend on that new image.
lines.zh: 今天我继续做服务上限报告，它不依赖新镜像。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no added production scope, right? Each action item keeps its original boundary.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不新增生产范围，对吧？各项待办保持原边界。

lines.en: Right, I still review rotation at two. Put the updated evidence beside the request.
lines.zh: 对，我仍两点评审轮转，把更新证据附在请求旁。

lines.en: That takes roughly an hour after follow-up. I'll note any missing evidence rather than guessing.
lines.zh: 跟进后整理大约一小时，缺证据就注明，不猜测。

lines.en: Can we take it offline for assertion details? The standup only needs the changed ownership.
lines.zh: 断言细节会后聊好吗？站会只需要知道责任变化。

lines.en: So, agreed, pair after this meeting. No new deadline for the blocked rollout today.
lines.zh: 同意，会后结对。今天不给受阻上线新增截止时间。

dialogues.scene: 生产扩展和驱动镜像受阻，重新分配今天可执行的任务。
dialogues.dir: linux/0113-转向证据，不隐性扩大范围
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 承诺交付，不保证外部批准
dialogues.premise: 今日任务重排完成，各人确认周二站会前可交付的内容。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分辨个人交付承诺与外部依赖的估计。

lines.en: Okay, no blockers for evidence cleanup now. Tomorrow I'll bring the annotated rotation results.
lines.zh: 好，证据整理现在没有阻塞。明天带来标注好的轮转结果。

lines.en: What if review finds a safety issue? Don't promise deployment before we see results.
lines.zh: 评审发现安全问题怎么办？看到结果前不能承诺部署。

lines.en: Right, I'm committing to evidence, not deployment. Any review issue stays in the report.
lines.zh: 对，我承诺交证据，不承诺部署。评审问题保留在报告里。

lines.en: I'll bring completed permission tests tomorrow. Driver coverage remains conditional on image delivery.
lines.zh: 明天我交完成的权限测试，驱动覆盖仍以镜像到位为前提。

lines.en: I'm on it for the limits report. I'll close the loop on effective process settings.
lines.zh: 上限报告我来做，确认实际进程设置并闭环。

lines.en: Just to confirm, report blocked items too, right? Silence doesn't mean they've been completed.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，也报告阻塞事项，对吧？不说不代表完成。

lines.en: Yes, what's the ETA from the approver? If unknown, say unknown rather than inventing one.
lines.zh: 对，审批方预计什么时候回复？未知就说未知，不能编时间。

lines.en: Still unknown, I'll ask again around noon. That's a follow-up commitment, not an approval estimate.
lines.zh: 仍未知，我中午左右再问。这是跟进承诺，不是批准时间估计。

lines.en: Have I missed anything for tomorrow's check-in? I have tests, image status, and review feedback.
lines.zh: 明天进度检查我漏了什么吗？我记下测试、镜像状态和评审反馈。

lines.en: So, add Anika's service limit evidence too. Roughly the same short format tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 再加Anika的服务上限证据，明早仍保持类似简短形式。

dialogues.scene: 今日任务重排完成，各人确认周二站会前可交付的内容。
dialogues.dir: linux/0114-承诺交付，不保证外部批准
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 结转阻塞，结束站会
dialogues.premise: 交付与依赖已确认，简短总结后结束站会并安排会后讨论。
dialogues.listeningTask: 复述保留的阻塞事项与会后评审安排。

lines.en: Just to recap, carry forward the blocked expansion. Today's focus stays evidence and test coverage.
lines.zh: 小结一下，受阻扩展结转。今天仍聚焦证据和测试覆盖。

lines.en: Rotation feedback at two, approval after coverage. No production restart is authorized by this standup.
lines.zh: 两点给轮转反馈，覆盖完整后才批准。站会不授权生产重启。

lines.en: Okay, the rollout remains blocked on approval. I'll update that dependency around lunchtime today.
lines.zh: 好，上线仍受审批阻塞。我今天午饭前后更新该依赖。

lines.en: And the driver image is still pending. I'll report availability without assuming test success.
lines.zh: 驱动镜像仍未到位，我会报告可用性，不假定测试成功。

lines.en: My action item stays the limits report. Effective settings and resource impact both included.
lines.zh: 我的待办仍是上限报告，包括实际设置和资源影响。

lines.en: Just to confirm, take it offline for details, right? Keep remaining implementation discussion outside standup.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，细节会后单独聊，对吧？剩余实现讨论留在站会外。

lines.en: Yes, I can join the review thread. Please keep separate changes in separate requests.
lines.zh: 是，我可以参与评审讨论。不同变更继续分开提请求。

lines.en: Roughly ten minutes after this for pairing. Hannah and I will check the assertions.
lines.zh: 会后大约十分钟结对，我和Hannah检查断言。

lines.en: That fits before my next meeting starts. I'll link results rather than repeat details tomorrow.
lines.zh: 能赶在下次会议前完成，明天附结果链接，不重复细节。

lines.en: So, we're done with today's standup. Next check-in tomorrow, same time and owners.
lines.zh: 今天站会结束。明天同一时间检查进展，负责人不变。

dialogues.scene: 交付与依赖已确认，简短总结后结束站会并安排会后讨论。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 请求堆积
dialogues.premise: 订单API延迟上升，先确认等待发生在哪一层。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分等待连接和查询正在执行。

lines.en: The pool is exhausted on orders. The error rate spiked after nine.
lines.zh: 订单服务连接池耗尽，九点后错误率猛涨。

lines.en: Are requests waiting for connections? Or already running inside the database?
lines.zh: 请求在等连接，还是已在数据库里执行？

lines.en: Mostly waiting before any query starts. About two hundred requests are queued.
lines.zh: 大部分还没开始查询就卡住了，大约两百个请求在排队。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, writes still succeed, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。确认一下，写入仍有成功的，对吧？

lines.en: Some do, but clients time out. Don't assume failed responses mean failed writes.
lines.zh: 有些成功，但客户端超时。不能把响应失败等同于写入失败。

lines.en: Let me tail the log first. I'll separate checkout waits from execution.
lines.zh: 我先盯日志，把借连接等待和执行耗时分开。

lines.en: Good. Keep client retries bounded too. Repeated writes could make this worse.
lines.zh: 好，也限制客户端重试。重复写入可能让问题更严重。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for evidence? A rough estimate will help us.
lines.zh: 那预计多久有证据？给个大概时间便于安排。

lines.en: I'll check duplicate order protection now. We need that before suggesting retries.
lines.zh: 我现在检查订单去重保护，建议重试前必须确认。

lines.en: About two minutes for pool metrics. No database restart while we're checking.
lines.zh: 连接池指标大约两分钟拿到，检查期间不重启数据库。

dialogues.scene: 订单API延迟上升，先确认等待发生在哪一层。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 借出不等于正在查询
dialogues.premise: 排队发生在获取连接前，开始对照池状态与数据库会话。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出池借出计数与活跃查询数不是同一指标。

lines.en: Forty checked-out connections, none available now. The pool is exhausted across three workers.
lines.zh: 四十条连接全部借出，没有可用连接，三台工作实例的池都耗尽了。

lines.en: Does checked out mean running queries? Compare that with actual session activity.
lines.zh: 借出就代表在执行查询吗？和实际会话活动对照一下。

lines.en: No, ownership stays with the application. Some borrowed connections aren't executing anything.
lines.zh: 不是，连接仍由应用持有，有些借出的连接没有执行任何操作。

lines.en: Just to confirm, same workers, right? Don't mix global and local counts.
lines.zh: 确认一下，对照的是同一批实例，对吧？别混用全局和局部计数。

lines.en: Exactly. The database isn't at capacity. Raising every pool limit could overload it.
lines.zh: 对，数据库并未满载。把每个池上限都调高可能压垮数据库。

lines.en: Okay, I'm on it for mapping. I'll match session IDs to workers.
lines.zh: 好，我来做映射，把会话ID对应到工作实例。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on waits. We need ages, not just counts.
lines.zh: 我会观察等待情况，需要占用时长，不只是数量。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis has two branches. Slow work or connections never returned.
lines.zh: 当前假设有两个方向：执行太慢，或者连接从未归还。

lines.en: Idle sessions alone don't prove leakage. Pools normally keep idle sessions open.
lines.zh: 空闲会话本身不能证明泄漏，池通常会保留空闲会话。

lines.en: So, collect ownership and age together. Maybe both causes are contributing here.
lines.zh: 那就一起收集持有者和占用时长，也许两种原因都存在。

dialogues.scene: 排队发生在获取连接前，开始对照池状态与数据库会话。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 慢报表是真问题，但不是全部
dialogues.premise: 池已借满，数据库并非满载；先定位长时间运行的查询。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别慢查询能解释多少连接占用。

lines.en: Query execution time reached thirty seconds. Six report queries are still running.
lines.zh: 查询耗时达到三十秒，还有六条报表查询在执行。

lines.en: That explains six occupied connections today. What explains the other borrowed ones?
lines.zh: 这能解释六条连接被占用，其他借出的连接怎么解释？

lines.en: Not those reports, from this sample. Several checked-out connections have no owner.
lines.zh: 从这份样本看不是报表，有几条借出的连接已找不到请求持有者。

lines.en: So, don't rule that out yet. Reports still make timeouts more likely, right?
lines.zh: 所以别排除报表因素，它仍会增加超时概率，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. Match each timeout to ownership. A slow query isn't a leak.
lines.zh: 对，把每次超时和连接持有关系对应起来。慢查询不等于泄漏。

lines.en: The report scans old order rows. Maybe its missing filter explains that.
lines.zh: 报表扫描旧订单行，可能是漏掉筛选条件导致的。

lines.en: Check the plan before adding indexes. Today's incident isn't an indexing window.
lines.zh: 加索引前先查执行计划，今天的故障处理不是建索引窗口。

lines.en: A rushed index? Let's park that. What's the ETA for timeout traces?
lines.zh: 临时赶建索引先放一边，超时链路预计多久拿到？

lines.en: Two minutes with sampled request IDs. I'll avoid collecting customer payloads here.
lines.zh: 用采样请求ID，两分钟。我会避免收集客户业务内容。

lines.en: Okay, the working hypothesis stays split. We'll inspect the cancellation branch next.
lines.zh: 好，继续保留两个假设方向，下一步检查取消请求的分支。

dialogues.scene: 池已借满，数据库并非满载；先定位长时间运行的查询。

dialogues.title: 超时后谁归还连接
dialogues.premise: 六条慢报表不能解释全部占用；检查请求超时后的连接持有记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出泄漏的证据强度和待复现条件。

lines.en: A connection leak looks possible here. Timed-out requests don't record a return.
lines.zh: 这里可能存在连接泄漏，超时请求没有记录连接归还。

lines.en: Could that be missing logging instead? We need a controlled cancellation test.
lines.zh: 会不会只是漏记日志？需要受控的取消测试。

lines.en: Yes, it's a working hypothesis now. Query execution time alone can't prove it.
lines.zh: 对，现在只是工作假设，查询耗时本身不能证明泄漏。

lines.en: Just to confirm, isolated testing, right? Don't inject cancellations into live orders.
lines.zh: 确认一下，在隔离环境测，对吧？别对线上订单注入取消操作。

lines.en: Agreed. Save current metrics before mitigation. We can recover without proving everything.
lines.zh: 同意，缓解前保存指标，不必查清所有问题才恢复服务。

lines.en: Okay, I'm on it for reproduction. Same client version, synthetic orders only.
lines.zh: 好，我负责复现，使用同版本客户端和合成订单。

lines.en: I'll compare successful and cancelled requests. Both must release their borrowed resources.
lines.zh: 我会对比成功和取消请求，两种都必须释放借用资源。

lines.en: The root cause is still open. Maybe report delays expose this branch.
lines.zh: 根因仍未定，可能报表延迟让这个分支更容易被触发。

lines.en: That's plausible, but not confirmed yet. We need separate evidence for each link.
lines.zh: 合理，但还没确认，因果链的每一环都需要各自证据。

lines.en: So, first contain the request backlog. Then test that link without pressure.
lines.zh: 那先控制请求积压，再在没有线上压力的条件下验证因果联系。

dialogues.scene: 六条慢报表不能解释全部占用；检查请求超时后的连接持有记录。

dialogues.title: 限制队列，而不是无限加连接
dialogues.premise: 慢报表和泄漏假设并存，先决定有边界的缓解措施。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住限流对象、重试约束和不能恢复泄漏连接的原因。

lines.en: Use a bounded request queue here. Reject excess work before borrowing connections.
lines.zh: 这里使用有上限的请求队列，借连接之前拒绝超额工作。

lines.en: Okay, shed load from reports first. Keep order writes within safe limits.
lines.zh: 好，先减掉报表负载，让订单写入维持安全限额。

lines.en: That should buy us time today. But it won't reclaim a connection leak.
lines.zh: 这能为今天争取时间，但不能收回泄漏的连接。

lines.en: Correct. Tell clients to back off. A rejection shouldn't trigger endless retries.
lines.zh: 对，告诉客户端退避，被拒绝不应触发无限重试。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reports pause, right? Existing writes get time to finish.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报表暂停，对吧？给已有写入完成的时间。

lines.en: Yes, through the approved feature control. Don't kill every database session instead.
lines.zh: 是，通过批准的功能控制暂停，不是杀掉所有数据库会话。

lines.en: What's our rollback trigger for limits? Maybe legitimate orders start failing faster.
lines.zh: 限流的回退触发条件是什么？正常订单可能反而更快失败。

lines.en: Compare accepted writes and rejection counts. Stop tightening if useful throughput drops.
lines.zh: 对比成功接纳的写入和拒绝数，有效吞吐下降就别继续收紧。

lines.en: So, apply the limit on one worker. I'll verify idempotent retries with support.
lines.zh: 那先在一台实例施加限额，我和支持团队确认幂等重试。

lines.en: I'll watch database load during that. Then we can safely rotate workers.
lines.zh: 我在此期间观察数据库负载，之后才能安全滚动处理实例。

dialogues.scene: 慢报表和泄漏假设并存，先决定有边界的缓解措施。

dialogues.title: 逐台排空并重建应用池
dialogues.premise: 报表暂停且单实例限流验证通过，准备回收滞留连接。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区别应用实例排空与重启整个数据库。

lines.en: I'll drain the worker marked A. New requests now go elsewhere safely.
lines.zh: 我排空A实例，新请求现在安全地送往其他实例。

lines.en: Do the remaining workers have capacity? Keep the bounded request queue enabled.
lines.zh: 其他实例有容量吗？有上限的请求队列继续启用。

lines.en: Yes, the lower traffic fits now. About five writes remain on A.
lines.zh: 有，降低后的流量现在能承受，A上还有大约五笔写入。

lines.en: Okay, wait for those writes, right? This is still a temporary workaround.
lines.zh: 好，等那些写入结束，对吧？这仍是临时缓解。

lines.en: Check outcomes before closing the pool. Cancellation doesn't guarantee a transaction stopped.
lines.zh: 关闭池之前检查结果，取消请求不能保证事务已停止。

lines.en: The five writes have completed now. I'll restart this application worker next.
lines.zh: 五笔写入现在都完成了，接下来重启这台应用实例。

lines.en: Not the database. Keep that distinction. I'll keep an eye on routing.
lines.zh: 不是重启数据库，要区分清楚。我会观察路由。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for checks? Maybe two minutes before another worker.
lines.zh: 检查预计多久？也许等两分钟再处理另一台。

lines.en: Two minutes after A returns healthy. Verify fresh writes and connection releases.
lines.zh: A恢复健康后两分钟，验证新写入和连接释放。

lines.en: I'm on it for session counts. We'll stop if database connections surge.
lines.zh: 我负责会话数，数据库连接暴涨就停止。

dialogues.scene: 报表暂停且单实例限流验证通过，准备回收滞留连接。

dialogues.title: 连接能借到，但修复尚未完成
dialogues.premise: 逐台排空重启结束，限流和报表暂停仍保持。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解指标恢复不能证明泄漏修好了。

lines.en: Connection checkout time is normal again. Each worker has available connections now.
lines.zh: 借连接等待恢复正常，每台实例现在都有可用连接。

lines.en: What about checked-out connections over time? A fresh pool can hide leakage.
lines.zh: 借出连接随时间怎么变化？新建池可能掩盖泄漏。

lines.en: They're stable under the reduced traffic. That doesn't prove cancellation is fixed.
lines.zh: 在降低流量后计数稳定，但不代表取消分支修好了。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reports stay paused, right? Don't remove both safeguards together.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报表仍暂停，对吧？别同时撤掉两种保护。

lines.en: Agreed. We're back to baseline now. State the limits with that update.
lines.zh: 同意，现在回到基线，更新时要一并说明限流仍在。

lines.en: If the pool is exhausted again, stop. Maybe another path holds connections too.
lines.zh: 如果池再耗尽就停止，也许还有其他分支持有连接。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation tonight. Track connection age beside checkout waits.
lines.zh: 今晚继续观察，连接占用时长和借连接等待一起跟踪。

lines.en: Okay, isolated testing is running now. The first cancelled request retained ownership.
lines.zh: 好，隔离测试在进行，首个被取消请求仍持有连接。

lines.en: Repeat it against the current release. One sample isn't the complete diagnosis.
lines.zh: 针对当前发布版本重复测试，一份样本不是完整诊断。

lines.en: So, keep recovery and repair separate. We'll review that test evidence next.
lines.zh: 那就把恢复和修复分开，下一步评审测试证据。

dialogues.scene: 逐台排空重启结束，限流和报表暂停仍保持。

dialogues.title: 复现超时清理缺口
dialogues.premise: 线上指标恢复，隔离测试继续验证取消后连接未归还。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出已确认的代码缺陷和仍待完成的报表优化。

lines.en: The timeout cleanup path misses release. Ten cancellations retained ten borrowed connections.
lines.zh: 超时清理分支漏掉释放，十次取消滞留了十条借用连接。

lines.en: Did normal requests release them correctly? We need the successful control too.
lines.zh: 正常请求能正确释放吗？也需要成功请求的对照。

lines.en: Yes, normal requests return them consistently. That confirms this connection leak now.
lines.zh: 能，正常请求稳定归还连接，现在确认了这一处泄漏。

lines.en: Okay, test exceptions as well, right? Maybe cancellation isn't the sole broken branch.
lines.zh: 好，也测试异常分支，对吧？取消可能不是唯一有问题的分支。

lines.en: And check open transaction cleanup separately. Returning a dirty connection isn't safe.
lines.zh: 还要单独检查未结束事务的清理，归还带事务状态的连接不安全。

lines.en: I'm on it with structured cleanup. Release follows transaction outcome handling now.
lines.zh: 我用结构化清理修复，现在处理好事务结果后才释放连接。

lines.en: The smoke test must include timeouts. Healthy requests alone won't cover this.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试必须包括超时，只有正常请求覆盖不到这里。

lines.en: Query execution time remains a separate issue. Reports still need their filter reviewed.
lines.zh: 查询耗时仍是单独的问题，报表筛选条件仍需评审。

lines.en: Keep that action item after mitigation. Don't bundle an untested query rewrite.
lines.zh: 缓解后保留这个行动项，别捆绑未经测试的查询重写。

lines.en: So, stage the cleanup fix first. Reports resume only after separate validation.
lines.zh: 那先灰度清理修复，报表要单独验证后才恢复。

dialogues.scene: 线上指标恢复，隔离测试继续验证取消后连接未归还。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 恢复状态不掩盖剩余限制
dialogues.premise: 清理修复通过隔离测试和单实例灰度，订单指标稳定，报表仍暂停。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分辨客户可见恢复、修复灰度和未恢复功能。

lines.en: Requests are draining without new buildup. Support can report order processing recovered.
lines.zh: 请求积压正在消化，没有新增堆积，支持团队可报告订单处理恢复。

lines.en: Include which functions remain restricted now. Reports are still unavailable to users.
lines.zh: 写清哪些功能仍受限，用户目前仍不能使用报表。

lines.en: Connection checkout time stays near baseline. The cleanup canary passed cancellation checks.
lines.zh: 借连接等待保持接近基线，清理修复的灰度通过取消测试。

lines.en: Okay, no full repair claim, right? The temporary workaround still includes limits.
lines.zh: 好，别宣称全部修好，对吧？临时缓解还包括限流。

lines.en: Yes. Expand the fix in batches. Observe each batch before relaxing limits.
lines.zh: 对，分批扩展修复，每批观察后才放宽限额。

lines.en: What's the ETA for report recovery? Maybe tomorrow after the query review.
lines.zh: 报表恢复预计什么时候？也许明天查询评审后。

lines.en: Call that an estimate, not commitment. Include the escalation path for regressions.
lines.zh: 说明这是估计，不是承诺，也写上回归异常的升级联系路径。

lines.en: So, circle back in thirty minutes. Earlier if waiting requests start rising.
lines.zh: 那三十分钟后再更新，等待请求上升就提前。

lines.en: I'll watch accepted throughput during expansion. Low errors with fewer orders isn't recovery.
lines.zh: 我在扩展时观察有效吞吐，订单少了而错误低不算恢复。

lines.en: Agreed, throughput matches the expected demand. I'll attach that evidence to support.
lines.zh: 同意，吞吐符合预期需求，我把证据附给支持团队。

dialogues.scene: 清理修复通过隔离测试和单实例灰度，订单指标稳定，报表仍暂停。
dialogues.dir: database/0124-恢复状态不掩盖剩余限制

dialogues.title: 把清理保证写进测试
dialogues.premise: 清理修复已分批完成，限额逐步放宽且稳定，报表优化仍待验收。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住代码、查询和监控三类任务的负责人及期限。

lines.en: Every exit must return the connection. The timeout cleanup path now does.
lines.zh: 每个退出分支都必须归还连接，超时清理分支现在也做到了。

lines.en: After resolving transaction state, of course. Tests must enforce that ordering too.
lines.zh: 当然要先处理事务状态，测试也必须保证这个顺序。

lines.en: Okay, checked-out connections need age alerts. Counts alone hid abandoned ownership here.
lines.zh: 好，借出连接需要占用时长告警，这次只看数量掩盖了持有关系丢失。

lines.en: Who's picking this up by Friday? Hannah, you own those alerts, right?
lines.zh: 谁周五前接这个任务？Hannah，告警由你负责，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, with a bounded cancellation test. I'll compare occupancy before and after.
lines.zh: 是，也加上有上限的取消测试，对比前后占用。

lines.en: My action item is regression coverage. I'll add exception cases by tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是回归覆盖，明天前加上异常场景。

lines.en: I'll review retry limits with clients. Maybe our timeout budget needs adjustment.
lines.zh: 我和客户端评审重试限额，可能超时预算也需要调整。

lines.en: I'll review the report plan tomorrow. Slow reports triggered waits, not every leak.
lines.zh: 我明天评审报表执行计划，慢报表引发等待，但并非所有泄漏都由它解释。

lines.en: Report recovery needs its own evidence. Keep that acceptance separate from cleanup.
lines.zh: 报表恢复要有自己的证据，验收与连接清理分开。

lines.en: So, close the loop next Friday. Bring test results, not just closed tickets.
lines.zh: 那下周五闭环，带测试结果，不只是关闭的工单。

dialogues.scene: 清理修复已分批完成，限额逐步放宽且稳定，报表优化仍待验收。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 交的是演练，不是生产切换
dialogues.premise: 夜班交接恢复演练，先明确数据、环境和验收状态。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清接班责任不代表批准生产使用。

lines.en: I'll hand over the restore drill. The backup manifest is in our ticket.
lines.zh: 我交接恢复演练，备份清单在工单里。

lines.en: Is this connected to production anywhere? I need the environment boundary first.
lines.zh: 它有任何地方连着生产吗？先明确环境边界。

lines.en: No, a separate test network throughout. Just to confirm, no live cutover, right?
lines.zh: 没有，全程单独测试网络。确认一下，不做线上切换，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, synthetic orders and test credentials. Outbound payment calls are blocked too.
lines.zh: 对，合成订单和测试凭据，对外支付调用也阻断了。

lines.en: Good. Is data validation finished yet? Starting the database isn't full acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，数据验证完成了吗？数据库启动不等于完整验收。

lines.en: Only the initial checks have passed. Full reconciliation still needs your shift.
lines.zh: 只有首批检查通过，完整对账还需要你们班完成。

lines.en: Then show the escalation path clearly. I'll take ownership after reviewing evidence.
lines.zh: 那写清升级联系路径，评审证据后我再接责。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for review? About ten minutes for this handoff.
lines.zh: 好，评审预计多久？这次交接大约十分钟。

lines.en: That works if the evidence opens. Have I missed anything about access?
lines.zh: 证据能打开就可以，访问权限方面我漏了什么吗？

lines.en: So, access is through approved accounts. No production secrets copied into notes.
lines.zh: 那访问使用批准账户，记录里没有复制生产密钥。

dialogues.scene: 夜班交接恢复演练，先明确数据、环境和验收状态。

dialogues.title: 核实基础备份和来源链
dialogues.premise: 隔离边界明确，接班方核对基础备份标识与文件校验。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别备份创建时间、完成时间和恢复目标。

lines.en: The base backup started at midnight. It completed at twenty past, UTC.
lines.zh: 基础备份午夜开始，UTC零点二十分完成。

lines.en: Which backup identifier did you restore? Filenames alone aren't enough provenance evidence.
lines.zh: 恢复的是哪个备份标识？只看文件名不足以证明来源。

lines.en: Drill backup B seventeen, recorded here. Its backup manifest matches verified file checksums.
lines.zh: 演练备份B17，记录在这里，备份清单和已核验文件校验和一致。

lines.en: Just to confirm, drill source only, right? Not a convenient untracked production copy.
lines.zh: 确认一下，只用演练数据源，对吧？不是随手拿的未追踪生产副本。

lines.en: Yes, the dataset approval is attached. Were encryption and restore access tested?
lines.zh: 是，数据集批准记录已附，加密和恢复权限测试了吗？

lines.en: They were, through the approved key service. We recorded outcomes, not secret values.
lines.zh: 测了，通过批准的密钥服务，记录结果而非密钥值。

lines.en: Let me tail the log next. I want the backup identity during startup.
lines.zh: 接下来我盯日志，看启动时确认的备份标识。

lines.en: Okay, I'm on it for that link. Maybe the storage view needs refreshing.
lines.zh: 好，我提供链接，存储视图可能需要刷新。

lines.en: The startup record matches B seventeen. That removes one source mismatch concern.
lines.zh: 启动记录匹配B17，排除了一个来源不匹配疑点。

lines.en: So, our working hypothesis has verified provenance. Next separate backup time from target.
lines.zh: 那当前假设有已验证来源，下一步区分备份时间和恢复目标。

dialogues.scene: 隔离边界明确，接班方核对基础备份标识与文件校验。
dialogues.dir: database/0147-核实基础备份和来源链

dialogues.title: 五分钟差距是设计边界
dialogues.premise: B17基础备份来源确认，核对模拟故障和恢复目标时间。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂恢复点、数据损失窗口和提交边界。

lines.en: The recovery target is two ten UTC. Simulated failure happens five minutes later.
lines.zh: 恢复目标是UTC两点十分，模拟故障发生在五分钟后。

lines.en: So transactions after that point aren't expected? Even if their logs are available?
lines.zh: 所以不期望包含目标点后的事务，即使日志可用？

lines.en: Correct, this drill tests a chosen point. We expect commits through two ten.
lines.zh: 对，这次测试选定时间点，期望包含截至两点十分的提交。

lines.en: Just to confirm, all timestamps UTC, right? We can rule that out as ambiguity.
lines.zh: 确认一下，全是UTC，对吧？可以排除时区歧义。

lines.en: And the target setting is inclusive? Transactions commit, not start, at that boundary.
lines.zh: 目标设置包含边界吗？看的是事务提交时间，不是开始时间。

lines.en: Yes, inclusive and the timeline checked. The base backup precedes that target safely.
lines.zh: 是，包含边界且时间线已检查，基础备份早于目标。

lines.en: Just to recap, five minutes intentionally excluded. That's recovery-point scope, not restore duration.
lines.zh: 小结一下，有意排除五分钟，这是恢复点范围，不是恢复耗时。

lines.en: Exactly, about five minutes of simulated changes. We mustn't call that zero loss.
lines.zh: 对，大约五分钟模拟变更，不能称零损失。

lines.en: Have I missed anything about target selection? Was that loss window approved beforehand?
lines.zh: 恢复点选择方面还有遗漏吗？这个损失窗口提前批准了吗？

lines.en: Okay, yes, the drill sponsor approved it. Final success still requires data checks.
lines.zh: 好，是，演练负责人批准了，但最终成功仍要数据校验。

dialogues.scene: B17基础备份来源确认，核对模拟故障和恢复目标时间。
dialogues.dir: database/0148-五分钟差距是设计边界
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 回放停止在目标点
dialogues.premise: 恢复目标和时区明确，核对日志连续性与回放停止记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别日志归档可用、回放完成和允许接入应用。

lines.en: Archived WAL covers the whole required chain. Segments remain available through two fifteen.
lines.zh: 归档WAL覆盖所需完整链，日志段可用到两点十五分。

lines.en: Did replay stop at the requested point? Availability beyond it doesn't change scope.
lines.zh: 回放停在请求目标点了吗？后面的日志可用不改变范围。

lines.en: Yes, logs show the recovery target reached. We inspected that before test access.
lines.zh: 是，日志显示达到恢复目标，开放测试访问前检查过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, isolation remained intact, right? No application production endpoint was changed.
lines.zh: 确认一下，隔离始终保持，对吧？没有改任何应用生产端点。

lines.en: Let me tail the log myself. I see no missing segment warnings.
lines.zh: 我自己盯日志，没有看到缺日志段警告。

lines.en: The backup manifest checks passed before replay. Timeline and target settings are attached.
lines.zh: 回放前备份清单校验通过，时间线和目标设置已附。

lines.en: Was recovery left paused or ended? I need the current server state.
lines.zh: 恢复还暂停着还是已结束？需要明确服务器当前状态。

lines.en: It ended under the reviewed drill procedure. Test access opened after boundary checks.
lines.zh: 按评审过的演练流程结束，边界检查后开放测试访问。

lines.en: So a smoke test can run. That still doesn't prove every row.
lines.zh: 那可以跑冒烟测试，但仍不能证明每一行正确。

lines.en: Okay, maybe summarize those checks next. Keep completed steps distinct from acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，接下来总结检查吧，把已完成步骤和验收分开。

dialogues.scene: 恢复目标和时区明确，核对日志连续性与回放停止记录。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 对账要按同一个时间点
dialogues.premise: 回放达到目标点并开放隔离测试访问，核验目标点前后数据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出行数匹配还不足够，以及为何不能直接比当前生产。

lines.en: Initial reconciliation checks passed for sampled tenants. Counts and payment totals match references.
lines.zh: 抽样租户初步对账通过，行数和付款总额匹配参考值。

lines.en: Which reference time does that represent? Current source totals would be wrong.
lines.zh: 参考值代表哪个时间？当前数据源总额不能直接比较。

lines.en: The frozen drill ledger at two ten. It matches our recovery target exactly.
lines.zh: 两点十分的冻结演练账本，准确匹配恢复目标。

lines.en: Just to confirm, boundary markers too, right? Counts can match with wrong rows.
lines.zh: 确认一下，也查边界标记，对吧？行错了也可能数量一致。

lines.en: Yes, show commits around that boundary. We need positive and negative evidence.
lines.zh: 对，展示边界前后的提交，需要存在和不存在两类证据。

lines.en: The two-oh-nine-fifty-eight commit is present. The two-ten-oh-two commit is correctly absent.
lines.zh: 两点九分五十八秒提交存在，两点十分零二秒提交正确地不存在。

lines.en: Good, the smoke test checks references too. But full tenant reconciliation remains unfinished.
lines.zh: 好，冒烟测试也核对关联关系，但完整租户对账仍没完成。

lines.en: I'm on it for query evidence links. Maybe larger tenants need longer checks.
lines.zh: 我提供查询证据链接，大租户检查可能更久。

lines.en: Full validation? We can rule that out. A sample doesn't cover every tenant.
lines.zh: 完整验收？这可以排除。抽样并不覆盖每个租户。

lines.en: Okay, label the sample coverage clearly. The next shift owns remaining checks.
lines.zh: 好，清楚标记抽样覆盖，下个班负责剩余检查。

dialogues.scene: 回放达到目标点并开放隔离测试访问，核验目标点前后数据。
dialogues.dir: database/0150-对账要按同一个时间点
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 四十二分钟不是三十分钟达标
dialogues.premise: 首批数据校验通过，核算恢复步骤耗时及尚未完成的最终验收。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分恢复点差距与恢复耗时目标。

lines.en: Restore elapsed time reached forty-two minutes. We started at three, UTC today.
lines.zh: 恢复已耗时四十二分钟，今天UTC三点开始。

lines.en: That's through the initial checked access? Final application acceptance isn't done yet.
lines.zh: 这是到首批经过检查的访问为止？最终应用验收还没完成。

lines.en: Yes, thirty-three minutes restoring and replaying. Nine more minutes for initial checks.
lines.zh: 对，恢复和回放三十三分钟，初步检查又九分钟。

lines.en: Just to confirm, target was thirty, right? The recovery window already exceeded that.
lines.zh: 确认一下，目标是三十分钟，对吧？恢复时间已经超了。

lines.en: Correct. Don't stop the clock retroactively. Remaining reconciliation checks add more elapsed time.
lines.zh: 对，别倒推提前停表，剩余对账检查还会增加耗时。

lines.en: The recovery target still excludes five minutes. That's separate from these forty-two minutes.
lines.zh: 恢复目标仍排除五分钟数据，这与四十二分钟耗时是两回事。

lines.en: Where did the extra time accumulate? Measure download, replay, and validation separately.
lines.zh: 多出来的时间在哪？分别测下载、回放和验证。

lines.en: Download took longer than our rehearsal. Maybe bandwidth limits explain part of it.
lines.zh: 下载比预演久，带宽限制可能解释一部分。

lines.en: What's the ETA for final checks? Call it provisional until jobs finish.
lines.zh: 最终检查预计何时完成？任务结束前只能说暂估。

lines.en: Okay, roughly another twenty minutes estimated. No completed recovery-time claim before acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，估计再二十分钟左右，验收前不宣称恢复耗时已最终确定。

dialogues.scene: 首批数据校验通过，核算恢复步骤耗时及尚未完成的最终验收。
dialogues.dir: database/0151-四十二分钟不是三十分钟达标
dialogues.audio: 0151-四十二分钟不是三十分钟达标.mp3
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 剩余校验逐项交责
dialogues.premise: 耗时目标已超出，完整对账和应用行为测试还需接班完成。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住未完成事项、负责人和停止条件。

lines.en: Pending validation covers three large tenants. Application retry behavior also needs testing.
lines.zh: 待验证项包括三个大租户，还要测应用重试行为。

lines.en: I'll own the remaining reconciliation checks. Where are expected totals and job IDs?
lines.zh: 我负责剩余对账，预期总额和任务ID在哪里？

lines.en: In the handoff ticket, beside coverage. I'm on it for read access confirmation.
lines.zh: 交接工单里，在覆盖记录旁边，我确认读取权限。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for retries? Lukas, the test harness is yours, right?
lines.zh: 谁接重试测试？Lukas，测试工具由你负责，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, using synthetic writes on a clone. I'll preserve the restored reference database.
lines.zh: 是，在克隆上用合成写入测试，保留恢复参考库不变。

lines.en: Good, retries can change test data. About ten cases cover the known branches.
lines.zh: 好，重试会改变测试数据，大约十个用例覆盖已知分支。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on failed totals. A mismatch means halt, not patch rows.
lines.zh: 我关注总额失败，不匹配就暂停，不是直接修补行。

lines.en: Okay, another action item is timing analysis. I'll separate transfer from replay tomorrow.
lines.zh: 好，另一个行动项是耗时分析，明天我拆分传输和回放。

lines.en: Maybe we need automated validation preparation. But don't weaken checks for faster numbers.
lines.zh: 可能需要自动准备校验，但别为数字更快而削弱检查。

lines.en: So, update each item with evidence. Completion needs results, not a started job.
lines.zh: 那每项都带证据更新，完成需要结果，不是任务已经启动。

dialogues.scene: 耗时目标已超出，完整对账和应用行为测试还需接班完成。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 接班方复查隔离边界
dialogues.premise: 剩余任务已分配，接班方追问恢复环境和写测试克隆的访问边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清测试克隆不改变恢复参考点。

lines.en: Show me the isolated restore environment. Can its test clone contact production services?
lines.zh: 给我看隔离恢复环境，测试克隆能联系生产服务吗？

lines.en: No, network policy blocks those routes. Both environments use drill credentials exclusively.
lines.zh: 不能，网络策略阻断那些路由，两种环境都只用演练凭据。

lines.en: The reference stays read-only for comparisons. The clone handles synthetic retry writes.
lines.zh: 参考库保持只读用于比较，克隆处理合成重试写入。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reference remains unchanged, right? New test writes aren't restored history.
lines.zh: 确认一下，参考库不变，对吧？新的测试写入不是恢复历史。

lines.en: Let me play that back carefully. Compare reference data, test behavior on clone.
lines.zh: 我仔细复述：参考库对数据，克隆测行为。

lines.en: Yes, label both connection profiles clearly. Maybe the similar names need stronger warnings.
lines.zh: 是，两个连接配置都清楚标记，相似名字可能需要更明显提示。

lines.en: Have I missed anything about cleanup? When will temporary drill credentials expire?
lines.zh: 清理方面还有遗漏吗？临时演练凭据什么时候过期？

lines.en: At noon, unless approved extension happens. Evidence remains in the restricted drill archive.
lines.zh: 中午过期，除非批准延期，证据保留在受限演练归档。

lines.en: Pending validation may need more time. Request extension before expiry, never bypass access.
lines.zh: 待验证可能更久，过期前申请延期，不能绕过访问控制。

lines.en: Okay, the recovery target stays documented. No clone results replace reference-point checks.
lines.zh: 好，恢复目标保持记录，克隆结果不能替代参考点检查。

dialogues.scene: 剩余任务已分配，接班方追问恢复环境和写测试克隆的访问边界。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 不匹配就暂停并保留证据
dialogues.premise: 接班方确认隔离和权限边界，明确失败时联系谁及不得做什么。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住数据不匹配、日志缺口和时间超标的不同处理。

lines.en: Recovery escalation starts with me tonight. Page the backup if I'm unreachable.
lines.zh: 今晚恢复异常先找我，联系不上就呼叫后备。

lines.en: What should halt the validation work? Data mismatch, missing logs, or unsafe access?
lines.zh: 什么情况暂停验证？数据不匹配、缺日志还是不安全访问？

lines.en: Any of those means stop and preserve evidence. No manual row corrections to pass.
lines.zh: 任何一种都停止并保留证据，不能手工改行让检查通过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no production promotion, right? A failed drill stays isolated throughout.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不提升成生产，对吧？失败演练全程保持隔离。

lines.en: And archived WAL gaps need source review. Don't invent a newer target instead.
lines.zh: 归档日志缺口需要复查来源，不能擅自换成更新恢复点。

lines.en: The escalation path includes backup storage owner. I'll attach their approved contact entry.
lines.zh: 升级路径也包括备份存储负责人，我附上批准联系人记录。

lines.en: What's the ETA if reconciliation stalls? We need a reporting deadline as well.
lines.zh: 对账卡住时预计何时更新？还需要报告期限。

lines.en: Update at four ten even if unfinished. Maybe sooner for any data mismatch.
lines.zh: 即使未完成也四点十分更新，数据不匹配则更早。

lines.en: The time target is already missed. That needs review, not unsafe shortcuts.
lines.zh: 耗时目标已未达标，需要评审，不是走不安全捷径。

lines.en: So, preserve logs and exact job outputs. We'll investigate before restarting the drill.
lines.zh: 那保留日志和准确任务输出，重做演练前先调查。

dialogues.scene: 接班方确认隔离和权限边界，明确失败时联系谁及不得做什么。
dialogues.dir: database/0154-不匹配就暂停并保留证据
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 接收责任，不提前签验收
dialogues.premise: 来源、恢复点、校验覆盖及升级条件明确，接班方复述并接责。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分交接接收和恢复演练最终验收。

lines.en: Handoff acceptance means I own next steps. It doesn't mean the drill passed.
lines.zh: 接收交接代表我负责下一步，不代表演练通过。

lines.en: Just to recap, source and point verified. Pending validation still blocks final acceptance.
lines.zh: 小结一下，来源和恢复点已核验，待验证仍阻止最终验收。

lines.en: Correct, sampled reconciliation checks passed already. Three large tenants remain with Hannah.
lines.zh: 对，抽样对账已通过，三个大租户由Hannah继续。

lines.en: And Lukas owns clone retry testing, right? The unchanged reference keeps its target.
lines.zh: Lukas负责克隆重试测试，对吧？不变的参考库保持目标点。

lines.en: I've got it from here for reconciliation. I'll report failures without editing results.
lines.zh: 对账我接下了，失败会如实报告，不修改结果。

lines.en: Okay, I'm available through four thirty. About twenty minutes remains our estimate.
lines.zh: 好，我四点半前都可联系，估计仍需二十分钟左右。

lines.en: I'll report at four ten either way. Final elapsed time stays open until acceptance.
lines.zh: 无论结果我四点十分更新，最终耗时到验收才确定。

lines.en: So, no claim of thirty-minute recovery. We'll review the timing gap tomorrow.
lines.zh: 那不宣称三十分钟恢复达标，明天评审时间差距。

lines.en: Evidence links and access work now. I accept the remaining validation responsibility.
lines.zh: 证据链接和权限现在都可用，我接收剩余验证责任。

lines.en: We'll close the loop after your results. Keep the drill separate from production.
lines.zh: 你们结果出来后闭环，演练继续与生产分开。

dialogues.scene: 来源、恢复点、校验覆盖及升级条件明确，接班方复述并接责。
dialogues.dir: database/0155-接收责任，不提前签验收
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 预测不是测量事实
dialogues.premise: 容量评审开场，用历史净增长和未来活动假设建立预测。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别历史数据、预测及不确定范围。

lines.en: Our growth forecast assumes current retention. Net storage grows two hundred gigabytes monthly.
lines.zh: 增长预测假设当前保留规则不变，存储每月净增两百GB。

lines.en: Is that measured growth or projection? Include how many months you sampled.
lines.zh: 这是测量增长还是预测？说明抽样了几个月。

lines.en: Measured across the last six months. Campaign demand is a separate assumption.
lines.zh: 过去六个月的测量，活动需求是单独的假设。

lines.en: Just to confirm, net after retention, right? Don't subtract those deletions twice.
lines.zh: 确认一下，是保留清理后的净值，对吧？别把删除重复扣除。

lines.en: Exactly. A campaign could change the slope. Show a high-growth case as well.
lines.zh: 对，活动可能改变增长斜率，也展示高增长情况。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis allows a larger burst. Maybe three times normal campaign writes.
lines.zh: 当前假设允许更大突发，活动写入可能为平时三倍。

lines.en: That's not three times monthly storage automatically. Burst duration matters for that estimate.
lines.zh: 这不自动等于月存储三倍，突发持续时间影响估计。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for campaign inputs? One action item is verified duration.
lines.zh: 好，活动输入预计什么时候拿到？一个行动项是核实持续时间。

lines.en: I'll ask business owners this afternoon. We shouldn't invent an exact demand curve.
lines.zh: 今天下午我问业务负责人，不能编一个精确需求曲线。

lines.en: So, I've got bandwidth for scenarios. First compare today's actual performance baseline.
lines.zh: 那我有精力做情景分析，先对比今天实际性能基线。

dialogues.scene: 容量评审开场，用历史净增长和未来活动假设建立预测。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: CPU不是唯一瓶颈
dialogues.premise: 增长口径确定，核对峰值CPU、交易延迟和报表磁盘压力。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出不同业务指标不能混为一个平均值。

lines.en: The peak load baseline shows sixty-eight percent CPU. Transaction latency remains within target.
lines.zh: 峰值基线显示CPU百分之六十八，交易延迟仍达标。

lines.en: Which percentile and which request class? An average could hide busy periods.
lines.zh: 哪个百分位、哪类请求？平均值可能掩盖繁忙时段。

lines.en: Transaction p ninety-five is one-forty milliseconds. Its target is two hundred milliseconds.
lines.zh: 交易p95是一百四十毫秒，目标两百毫秒。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reports measured separately, right? They aren't meeting that same target.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报表单独测，对吧？它不是满足同一个指标。

lines.en: Correct, reports reach nearly two seconds. Their scans coincide with disk queues.
lines.zh: 对，报表接近两秒，扫描与磁盘队列上升重叠。

lines.en: We can't rule that out as contention. Maybe a larger CPU won't help enough.
lines.zh: 不能排除资源争用，也许更多CPU帮助不够。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on I/O ceilings. Instance bandwidth and storage limits differ.
lines.zh: 我关注I/O上限，实例带宽和存储限制是两回事。

lines.en: The growth forecast increases both workloads. But it doesn't prove CPU saturation yet.
lines.zh: 增长预测会增加两类负载，但还不能证明CPU将饱和。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is avoidable scan pressure. Let's inspect the query before sizing.
lines.zh: 当前假设是可避免的扫描压力，估算规格前先查查询。

lines.en: Okay, keep that distinction in the notes. We need capacity and efficiency together.
lines.zh: 好，记录这种区分，容量和效率一起考虑。

dialogues.scene: 增长口径确定，核对峰值CPU、交易延迟和报表磁盘压力。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 扫描合理吗，筛选能下推吗
dialogues.premise: 交易达标但报表I/O压力高，查看查询计划及筛选行为。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分合理全扫和可避免的应用侧筛选。

lines.en: The report does a full table scan. It filters dates in application code.
lines.zh: 报表全表扫描，在应用代码里筛日期。

lines.en: Could that filter move into SQL? Keep date boundaries and timezone semantics identical.
lines.zh: 筛选能移到SQL里吗？日期边界和时区语义要相同。

lines.en: Yes, existing date indexes may help. Our working hypothesis needs representative query tests.
lines.zh: 可以，现有日期索引可能有用，当前假设需要代表性查询测试。

lines.en: Okay, test broad ranges too, right? A full scan isn't always wrong.
lines.zh: 好，也测宽范围，对吧？全扫不总是错的。

lines.en: Exactly, selectivity changes the right plan. Don't force indexes for every tenant.
lines.zh: 对，选择性会改变合理计划，别强制每个租户用索引。

lines.en: The smoke test checks output totals. Maybe date truncation needs special boundary cases.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试核对输出总额，日期截断可能需要特殊边界用例。

lines.en: Compare with the peak load baseline. A quiet test can exaggerate gains.
lines.zh: 与峰值基线对比，安静环境测试会夸大收益。

lines.en: Sharding immediately? Let's park that for now. What's the ETA for query evidence?
lines.zh: 立即分片先放一边，查询证据预计什么时候有？

lines.en: Two days for isolated load comparisons. Include large tenants and concurrent writes.
lines.zh: 两天完成隔离负载对比，包括大租户和并发写入。

lines.en: So, optimize before claiming hardware savings. Growth still needs its own storage plan.
lines.zh: 那先优化再谈省硬件，增长仍需要独立存储计划。

dialogues.scene: 交易达标但报表I/O压力高，查看查询计划及筛选行为。
dialogues.dir: database/0158-扫描合理吗，筛选能下推吗

dialogues.title: 两TB空闲不等于都能消耗
dialogues.premise: 查询优化可降低I/O，但净数据增长仍占存储，需要明确预留空间。
dialogues.listeningTask: 算清空闲、受保护预留和可用于增长的空间。

lines.en: Storage headroom is two terabytes physically. Six used, eight available, same decimal units.
lines.zh: 物理空闲两TB，已用六TB、可用八TB，都是十进制单位。

lines.en: How much of that is protected reserve? Temporary operations need space as well.
lines.zh: 其中多少是受保护预留？临时操作也需要空间。

lines.en: Twenty percent reserved, one-point-six terabytes today. That leaves four hundred gigabytes spendable.
lines.zh: 预留百分之二十，现在是一点六TB，可消耗空间剩四百GB。

lines.en: Just to confirm, about two months, right? At the measured net growth rate.
lines.zh: 确认一下，大约两个月，对吧？按测得的净增长率。

lines.en: Yes, before touching that protected reserve. Campaign growth could shorten it considerably.
lines.zh: 是，指触及受保护预留前，活动增长可能明显缩短时间。

lines.en: Our retention policy already informs growth forecast. We can't count unapproved deletion savings.
lines.zh: 保留规则已经计入预测，不能算未经批准的删除收益。

lines.en: Replica storage needs the same review. A bigger primary with undersized replicas fails.
lines.zh: 副本存储也要同样评审，主库变大而副本不足会失败。

lines.en: Okay, storage ordering is an action item. What's the ETA for delivery confirmation?
lines.zh: 好，申请存储是一个行动项，预计什么时候确认交付？

lines.en: Tomorrow for the supplier's delivery estimate. Actual provisioning may take three weeks.
lines.zh: 明天拿供应方交付估计，实际开通可能要三周。

lines.en: So, approve preparation without waiting for queries. Efficiency won't erase retained order growth.
lines.zh: 那批准准备，不必等查询优化，效率改善不会消除保留订单增长。

dialogues.scene: 查询优化可降低I/O，但净数据增长仍占存储，需要明确预留空间。
dialogues.dir: database/0159-两TB空闲不等于都能消耗

dialogues.title: 更大实例能买时间，也有上限
dialogues.premise: 存储扩容需提前准备，比较更大实例对性能的帮助及切换代价。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出CPU、I/O和切换窗口必须分别验证。

lines.en: Vertical scaling adds CPU and memory. It may not lift storage I/O limits.
lines.zh: 升单实例规格增加CPU和内存，但不一定提高存储I/O上限。

lines.en: It could buy us time for peaks. But our disk queues need measurement.
lines.zh: 它能为高峰争取时间，但磁盘队列需要测量。

lines.en: I favor it as a fallback. Maybe query gains won't cover campaign load.
lines.zh: 我倾向把它作为备用，查询收益可能不足以覆盖活动负载。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not approved execution, right? We still need a maintenance window.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不是批准执行，对吧？仍需要维护窗口。

lines.en: And a tested rollback trigger too. Instance changes can require restart or switchover.
lines.zh: 也需要验证过的回退触发条件，实例变更可能要求重启或切换。

lines.en: Storage headroom still needs separate expansion. More memory won't store another year's data.
lines.zh: 存储余量仍需独立扩容，更多内存不能存下一年的数据。

lines.en: The next size has a finite ceiling. We shouldn't promise unlimited runway here.
lines.zh: 下一规格也有上限，不能承诺无限增长空间。

lines.en: Okay, model one step and its cost. Compare it with the sharding option.
lines.zh: 好，估算升一级及成本，与分片方案比较。

lines.en: Include replica sizing and standby readiness. A writer upgrade isn't the whole fleet.
lines.zh: 包括副本规格和备用就绪，升级写库不是整个集群。

lines.en: So, run the larger-instance load test. Keep it reversible before changing production.
lines.zh: 那跑更大实例负载测试，改生产前确保可回退。

dialogues.scene: 存储扩容需提前准备，比较更大实例对性能的帮助及切换代价。

dialogues.title: 分片键解决分布，不解决所有查询
dialogues.premise: 垂直扩容是有限备用，讨论按租户分片的长期可能性。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出大租户热点、跨分片查询和事务取舍。

lines.en: Tenant ID is our proposed shard key. Most order operations stay within tenants.
lines.zh: 建议用租户ID作分片键，大多数订单操作在租户内。

lines.en: What happens to the largest tenant? One hot shard could remain the bottleneck.
lines.zh: 最大租户怎么办？一个热点分片可能仍是瓶颈。

lines.en: Yes, tenant sizes are very uneven. Our working hypothesis needs distribution simulation first.
lines.zh: 是，租户规模很不均，当前假设需要先模拟分布。

lines.en: Just to confirm, cross-tenant reports exist, right? Those won't become magically cheaper.
lines.zh: 确认一下，有跨租户报表，对吧？它们不会神奇地更便宜。

lines.en: Correct, fan-out adds coordination and latency. Global totals need a separate aggregation design.
lines.zh: 对，多分片查询增加协调和延迟，全局汇总需要独立聚合设计。

lines.en: Maybe tenant routing covers normal writes. Cross-tenant adjustments still need explicit transaction rules.
lines.zh: 租户路由可能覆盖普通写入，跨租户调整仍需明确事务规则。

lines.en: And rebalancing needs operational ownership too. More databases mean more recovery procedures.
lines.zh: 重平衡也需要运维负责人，数据库更多就有更多恢复流程。

lines.en: Okay, immediate sharding? Let's park that. Do we have bandwidth for research?
lines.zh: 好，立即分片先放一边，有精力做研究吗？

lines.en: Limited bandwidth, not an eight-week commitment. Compare vertical scaling with realistic staffing.
lines.zh: 精力有限，不是承诺八周完成，与垂直扩容比较时要用实际人手。

lines.en: So, prototype distribution on synthetic data. We shouldn't promise savings before that.
lines.zh: 那先用合成数据做分布原型，之前不承诺收益。

dialogues.scene: 垂直扩容是有限备用，讨论按租户分片的长期可能性。

dialogues.title: 双写不是免费的安全网
dialogues.premise: 租户分片仍需研究，比较数据迁移、双写和回退风险。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别原型、生产迁移和可验证的回退门槛。

lines.en: Migration risk includes missed and duplicate writes. Dual writing isn't automatic consistency protection.
lines.zh: 迁移风险包括漏写和重复写，双写不是自动一致性保护。

lines.en: Agreed, retries and ordering need explicit design. We don't have that implementation today.
lines.zh: 同意，重试和顺序需要明确设计，目前没有实现。

lines.en: Changing a shard key can move data. Recovery and reconciliation must cover each move.
lines.zh: 改分片键可能搬迁数据，恢复和对账必须覆盖每次移动。

lines.en: Just to confirm, research stays isolated, right? No production dual-write experiment this week.
lines.zh: 确认一下，研究保持隔离，对吧？本周不做生产双写实验。

lines.en: Yes, a smoke test isn't sufficient. We need failure and replay scenarios.
lines.zh: 是，冒烟测试不够，需要失败和回放场景。

lines.en: The rollback trigger needs data convergence evidence. Maybe reversing routing alone loses updates.
lines.zh: 回退触发条件需要数据收敛证据，单纯反向改路由可能丢更新。

lines.en: Exactly. Reversibility has to be demonstrated. It isn't just keeping the old database.
lines.zh: 对，必须证明可逆，不只是保留旧数据库。

lines.en: Okay, aggressive cutover dates? Let's park that. Storage deadlines are sooner than research.
lines.zh: 好，激进切换日期先放一边，存储期限比研究更近。

lines.en: Separate immediate capacity from long-term redesign. We can fund research without choosing migration.
lines.zh: 短期容量与长期重构分开，可以资助研究而不决定迁移。

lines.en: So, document unknowns and acceptance criteria. Costs come next, including this engineering work.
lines.zh: 那记录未知项和验收条件，接下来算成本，包括这些工程工作。

dialogues.scene: 租户分片仍需研究，比较数据迁移、双写和回退风险。
dialogues.dir: database/0162-双写不是免费的安全网

dialogues.title: 不只比较月租
dialogues.premise: 技术与迁移边界明确，对比基础设施、人力和维护成本。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出估价口径、共同存储成本和工期不确定性。

lines.en: Total cost of ownership includes engineering. The monthly bill isn't the whole comparison.
lines.zh: 总拥有成本包括工程投入，月账单不是全部比较。

lines.en: Vertical scaling adds eighteen hundred monthly. That's fleet cost, not just primary.
lines.zh: 垂直扩容每月增加一千八百，这是整个集群，不只是主库。

lines.en: Shards add roughly twenty-four hundred monthly. Engineering could take eight weeks or longer.
lines.zh: 分片每月约增加两千四百，工程可能八周或更久。

lines.en: Just to confirm, estimates, not quotes, right? And no guaranteed sharding savings yet.
lines.zh: 确认一下，是估计不是报价，对吧？也没有保证分片省钱。

lines.en: Correct, migration risk increases testing effort. On-call ownership adds ongoing staffing costs.
lines.zh: 对，迁移风险增加测试工作，值班责任增加持续人力成本。

lines.en: Storage expansion adds four hundred monthly separately. Both options still need that capacity.
lines.zh: 存储扩容另每月增加四百，两种方案都仍需这些容量。

lines.en: Query optimization needs about two engineer-weeks. Savings stay provisional until load tests.
lines.zh: 查询优化约需两个人周，压测前收益仍暂估。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for firm quotes? We have bandwidth for one pilot.
lines.zh: 好，明确报价预计何时？我们有精力做一个试点。

lines.en: Tomorrow for infrastructure estimates and lead times. Maybe procurement changes the delivery assumptions.
lines.zh: 明天拿基础设施估价和交付周期，采购可能改变交付假设。

lines.en: So, favor queries plus storage preparation. Keep the larger instance as contingency.
lines.zh: 那倾向查询优化加存储准备，更大实例保留作备用。

dialogues.scene: 技术与迁移边界明确，对比基础设施、人力和维护成本。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 试点要有真实验收门槛
dialogues.premise: 选择查询优化与存储准备，定义小范围只读报表试点及回退。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住正确性、交易影响和磁盘压力的验收条件。

lines.en: Approve a capacity pilot for reports. Isolated tests first, one region afterward.
lines.zh: 批准报表容量试点，先隔离测试，之后一个区域。

lines.en: Which tenants represent the actual skew? A tiny tenant isn't a useful pilot.
lines.zh: 哪些租户代表实际偏斜？一个小租户不是有效试点。

lines.en: One large and two smaller tenants. I'm on it with the feature switch.
lines.zh: 一个大租户和两个小租户，我负责功能开关。

lines.en: The full table scan should shrink selectively. Broad reports may still scan reasonably.
lines.zh: 选择性高的查询应减少全扫，宽范围报表仍可能合理扫描。

lines.en: Compare against the peak load baseline. Include transaction latency beside report improvements.
lines.zh: 与峰值基线对比，报表收益旁边也列交易延迟。

lines.en: Just to confirm, identical totals required, right? Faster wrong reports fail the pilot.
lines.zh: 确认一下，总额必须相同，对吧？更快但错误的报表算失败。

lines.en: Yes. Lower disk reads are another gate. Keep transaction latency below two hundred.
lines.zh: 是，磁盘读取下降也是门槛，交易延迟保持低于两百毫秒。

lines.en: Incorrect totals are the immediate rollback trigger. Maybe scan savings vary by date range.
lines.zh: 总额错误立即触发回退，扫描收益可能随日期范围变化。

lines.en: And sustained write regression halts expansion. Revert the query switch, preserve evidence.
lines.zh: 持续写回归也停止扩展，回退查询开关并保留证据。

lines.en: Okay, order storage for all nodes now. Pilot success won't postpone that preparation.
lines.zh: 好，现在为所有节点申请存储，试点成功也不推迟准备。

dialogues.scene: 选择查询优化与存储准备，定义小范围只读报表试点及回退。

dialogues.title: 短期容量与长期研究各有期限
dialogues.premise: 试点和存储准备获批，分片研究与备用扩容保持独立，确认责任及复查。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出决定、条件批准和未选择方案的区别。

lines.en: Our capacity guardrail protects twenty percent reserve. Alerts use forecast and remaining space.
lines.zh: 容量门槛保护百分之二十预留，告警同时用预测和剩余空间。

lines.en: Storage headroom must cover delivery lead time. Escalate if arrival risks that reserve.
lines.zh: 存储余量必须覆盖交付周期，预计交付触及预留就升级联系。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for delivery? Raj owns confirmations by tomorrow, right?
lines.zh: 交付谁接？Raj明天前负责确认，对吧？

lines.en: My action item is the capacity pilot. Evidence review is due in two weeks.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是容量试点，两周后评审证据。

lines.en: I'll check correctness and comparable load. Maybe campaign inputs change the acceptance range.
lines.zh: 我检查正确性和可比负载，活动输入可能改变验收范围。

lines.en: Yes, I'll update high-growth projections tomorrow. The protected reserve isn't emergency spending permission.
lines.zh: 是，我明天更新高增长预测，受保护预留不是随便应急消耗的许可。

lines.en: I'll test larger-instance fallback this week. Production switching still needs separate approval.
lines.zh: 我本周测试更大实例备用，生产切换仍需单独批准。

lines.en: Okay, sharding stays research, not a commitment. We'll review staffing after distribution results.
lines.zh: 好，分片仍是研究，不是承诺，分布结果出来后再评审人手。

lines.en: Bring both monthly costs and engineering effort. A cheap quote can hide operational expense.
lines.zh: 带月成本和工程投入，便宜报价可能藏着运维支出。

lines.en: So, close the loop in two weeks. No growth assumption becomes fact without evidence.
lines.zh: 那两周后闭环，没有证据就不把增长假设当事实。

dialogues.scene: 试点和存储准备获批，分片研究与备用扩容保持独立，确认责任及复查。

dialogues.title: 先对齐本周只读目标
dialogues.premise: 今日站会开始，先确认两天后演示的范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出演示目标、非目标与站会结束时间。

lines.en: Okay, we're keeping the read-only scope. Today's standup has a ten-minute hard stop.
lines.zh: 好，保持只读范围，今天站会十分钟到点结束。

lines.en: Does that exclude editing inventory records? Review complexity changes if writes sneak in.
lines.zh: 这排除修改资产记录吗？混入写功能会改变评审复杂度。

lines.en: Yes, listing and filtering records only. Just to confirm, bulk updates stay out, right?
lines.zh: 是，只列出和筛选记录，确认一下，批量更新不做，对吧？

lines.en: The demo should show two inventory pages. Maybe a third if the fixture is ready.
lines.zh: 演示展示两页资产，fixture就绪的话可能展示第三页。

lines.en: Two pages already exercise cursor handling. A third page isn't the acceptance gate.
lines.zh: 两页已覆盖游标处理，第三页不是验收关卡。

lines.en: Good, one action item is confirming ownership. Who has bandwidth for the parser review?
lines.zh: 好，一项任务是确认负责人，谁有时间评审解析器？

lines.en: I can review after my platform check. Send the focused change, not unrelated cleanup.
lines.zh: 平台检查后我能评审，发聚焦变更，不夹带无关整理。

lines.en: The export feature can wait another sprint. Let's park that until this demo works.
lines.zh: 导出功能可以等下个迭代，当前演示跑通前先放下。

lines.en: I'll report test progress after the implementation. We should surface blockers before assigning more work.
lines.zh: 实现进度后我汇报测试，增加任务前先暴露阻塞。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll cover the API dependency next. No production rollout is planned this week.
lines.zh: 同意，接着我说接口依赖，本周不计划生产上线。

dialogues.scene: 今日站会开始，先确认两天后演示的范围。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 昨天完成了什么
dialogues.premise: 只读范围明确，Raj报告实现进度与今日安排。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分已完成实现、待评审代码和未验收集成。

lines.en: The parser is up for review now. Yesterday I finished cursor parsing and filtering.
lines.zh: 解析器现在待评审，昨天完成游标解析与筛选。

lines.en: Does it run against the real endpoint? Or does that progress describe fixtures only?
lines.zh: 是用真实接口跑过，还是仅指fixture进度？

lines.en: Fixtures only until the contract is confirmed. Just to confirm, that's clearly labelled, right?
lines.zh: 契约确认前只用fixture，确认一下，已明确标注，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, my integration note states that limitation. The read-only scope hasn't changed since yesterday.
lines.zh: 是，我的集成说明写了这个限制，只读范围没有变化。

lines.en: Parser tests pass for valid cursors. Malformed cursor coverage still needs additional cases.
lines.zh: 合法游标测试通过，异常游标还需要补用例。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for those cases? A rough estimate is enough right now.
lines.zh: 好，补用例预计多久？现在给大概估算即可。

lines.en: I'll review the existing parser this morning. Additional tests can land in that change.
lines.zh: 今天上午评审现有解析器，新增测试可放同一变更。

lines.en: I'm on it before lunch, roughly two hours. Then I'll be heads-down on error handling.
lines.zh: 我午饭前做，大约两小时，之后专注错误处理。

lines.en: Please include the exact rejected input shapes. We need reproducible cases, not just descriptions.
lines.zh: 请附具体拒绝输入结构，需要可复现用例，不只是描述。

lines.en: I'll share the sanitized API samples too. That should keep our fixtures closer to reality.
lines.zh: 我也分享脱敏接口样本，让fixture更接近实际。

dialogues.scene: 只读范围明确，Raj报告实现进度与今日安排。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 评审有明确时段
dialogues.premise: 解析器待评审，Lukas尚有平台工作，站会协调排期。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出评审承诺与不能提前视为完成的事项。

lines.en: The review queue is my main blocker. The change is up for review already.
lines.zh: 主要阻塞是评审队列，变更已经提交评审。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth at eleven this morning. I can't promise approval before reading it.
lines.zh: 上午十一点我有时间，但读之前不能承诺通过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, eleven is review start, right? What's the ETA for initial feedback?
lines.zh: 确认一下，十一点开始评审，对吧？初次反馈预计什么时候？

lines.en: My integration branch depends on its output shape. I can still prepare the adapter tests.
lines.zh: 集成分支依赖输出结构，我仍能先准备适配器测试。

lines.en: Keep the interface description beside the change. Reviewers shouldn't reverse-engineer the expected output.
lines.zh: 变更旁放接口说明，不该让评审者反推预期输出。

lines.en: Okay, I'll add that description before eleven. Maybe ten minutes for the example outputs.
lines.zh: 好，十一点前补说明，示例输出可能需十分钟。

lines.en: Initial feedback should arrive before lunch. Larger design questions may need a separate discussion.
lines.zh: 午饭前给初次反馈，大的设计问题可能另需讨论。

lines.en: We'll circle back at the afternoon checkpoint. Don't mark the review complete before feedback.
lines.zh: 下午检查点再跟进，反馈前不标成评审完成。

lines.en: I can review test clarity in parallel. That doesn't replace Lukas's implementation review.
lines.zh: 我可并行审查测试清晰度，不能替代Lukas审实现。

lines.en: Good, I'll prepare integration fixtures meanwhile. That keeps progress moving without assuming interface approval.
lines.zh: 好，我同时准备集成fixture，不假设接口已获批准。

dialogues.scene: 解析器待评审，Lukas尚有平台工作，站会协调排期。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 演示成功不等于测试齐全
dialogues.premise: 评审时段确定，Hannah报告尚缺的异常路径测试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别异常游标、空页和取消操作三项测试缺口。

lines.en: There's a test coverage gap around pagination. Empty pages and repeated cursors aren't covered.
lines.zh: 分页存在测试缺口，空页和重复游标未覆盖。

lines.en: I'm on it with repeated cursor detection. A repeated token must stop pagination safely.
lines.zh: 重复游标检测我来做，重复令牌必须安全停止分页。

lines.en: An empty page can still have continuation. Don't automatically treat it as completion.
lines.zh: 空页仍可能带续页标识，不能自动当作结束。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the API allows that, right? I'll ask its owner for an example.
lines.zh: 确认一下，接口允许这种情况，对吧？我找负责人要例子。

lines.en: Okay, one action item per missing case. Maybe cancellation can pair with parser cleanup.
lines.zh: 好，每个缺口单列任务，取消操作可能与解析器释放资源一起做。

lines.en: We can't rule that out without tests. A successful demo doesn't exercise cancellation behavior.
lines.zh: 没测试就不能排除问题，演示成功没覆盖取消行为。

lines.en: I'll check resource ownership during review. Close the response when the user interrupts.
lines.zh: 评审时检查资源所有权，用户中断要关闭响应。

lines.en: A new paging framework would take longer. Let's park that and test our current loop.
lines.zh: 新分页框架会耗时更多，先放下，测试当前循环。

lines.en: I'll log the unresolved contract question separately. That shouldn't hide the known local gaps.
lines.zh: 未决契约问题单独记录，不能遮住已知本地缺口。

lines.en: Agreed, report test evidence at day's end. No claim of complete coverage until then.
lines.zh: 同意，日终报告测试证据，在那之前不宣称覆盖完整。

dialogues.scene: 评审时段确定，Hannah报告尚缺的异常路径测试。
dialogues.dir: coding/0189-演示成功不等于测试齐全
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 错误要可辨别也不泄密
dialogues.premise: 测试任务已分配，Raj汇报错误处理实现边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解标准错误输出、退出码与敏感信息过滤。

lines.en: Each failure now returns a structured error. Normal inventory output stays clean on stdout.
lines.zh: 失败现在返回结构化错误，标准输出保持纯资产数据。

lines.en: Where do human-readable diagnostics go then? Automation must distinguish failure from empty results.
lines.zh: 可读诊断发到哪里？自动化要区分失败与空结果。

lines.en: Stderr, with documented nonzero exit codes. Just to confirm, no tokens in diagnostics, right?
lines.zh: 标准错误输出，配非零退出码文档。确认一下，不含令牌，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, the read-only scope still needs redaction. Request metadata can contain sensitive query values.
lines.zh: 是，即使只读也需脱敏，请求元数据可能含敏感查询值。

lines.en: Let me tail the log in testing. I'll verify redaction with deliberately sensitive fixtures.
lines.zh: 测试时我检查日志，用专门敏感fixture验证脱敏。

lines.en: Okay, make exit-code documentation an action item. Maybe our shell examples need updates too.
lines.zh: 好，退出码文档列任务，shell示例可能也需更新。

lines.en: Don't catch every exception as authentication failure. Preserve distinct categories and safe diagnostic context.
lines.zh: 不要把所有异常都当认证失败，保留不同类别和安全诊断上下文。

lines.en: I'm on it with explicit exception categories. Unexpected failures retain a sanitized trace identifier.
lines.zh: 我做显式异常分类，意外失败保留脱敏追踪标识。

lines.en: I'll test malformed responses and permission denial. Those should produce different actionable error categories.
lines.zh: 我测试异常响应和权限拒绝，它们应产生可行动的不同错误类别。

lines.en: Good, that's enough detail for the standup. I'll bring sample failures to the follow-up.
lines.zh: 好，站会这些细节够了，会后我带失败样本。

dialogues.scene: 测试任务已分配，Raj汇报错误处理实现边界。
dialogues.dir: coding/0190-错误要可辨别也不泄密

dialogues.title: 接口契约由谁确认
dialogues.premise: 本地实现可推进，真实集成仍等资产API团队确认游标行为。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清外部依赖、负责人和fixture演示的限制。

lines.en: The API contract still needs owner confirmation. We're waiting on empty-page continuation behavior.
lines.zh: 接口契约仍需负责人确认，在等空页续页行为说明。

lines.en: Can the integration work continue with fixtures? Mark assumptions explicitly so they aren't forgotten.
lines.zh: 能用fixture继续集成吗？明确假设，避免遗忘。

lines.en: Yes, but real endpoint acceptance stays blocked. Just to confirm, that's not demo completion, right?
lines.zh: 可以，但真实接口验收仍阻塞，确认一下，这不算演示完成，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA from their owner? Use our escalation path if today's reply slips.
lines.zh: 好，对方负责人预计什么时候回复？今天没回就按升级路径联系。

lines.en: Keep the test coverage gap visible separately. External waiting doesn't prevent local boundary tests.
lines.zh: 本地测试缺口单独保留，等外部回复不影响本地边界测试。

lines.en: Maybe the cursor is opaque by design. I'll avoid parsing or modifying its contents.
lines.zh: 游标可能设计为不透明，我不会解析或修改内部内容。

lines.en: Good, pass it back exactly as received. Only validate the documented envelope and limits.
lines.zh: 好，原样传回，只验证文档规定的外层结构与限制。

lines.en: We'll circle back with the API lead. Anika, send the two concrete questions now.
lines.zh: 与接口负责人再跟进，Anika现在发两个具体问题。

lines.en: I can attach failing contract examples. That's more useful than a general compatibility question.
lines.zh: 我附失败契约样例，比笼统兼容问题更有用。

lines.en: I'll send them immediately after this standup. The owner suggested roughly three this afternoon.
lines.zh: 站会后立即发，对方说今天下午大约三点回复。

dialogues.scene: 本地实现可推进，真实集成仍等资产API团队确认游标行为。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 结对看测试而不是接管任务
dialogues.premise: 接口问题明确，Raj请求协助检查游标与取消测试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别结对协助的范围和任务责任归属。

lines.en: Could someone pair on it before lunch? I need help checking cancellation test design.
lines.zh: 午饭前能有人结对吗？需要帮忙检查取消测试设计。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for thirty minutes. We'll focus on the test coverage gap.
lines.zh: 我有半小时，聚焦测试覆盖缺口。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Raj keeps implementation ownership, right? Hannah helps validate the failure cases.
lines.zh: 确认一下，实现仍归Raj，对吧？Hannah协助验证失败用例。

lines.en: I'm on it for realistic response samples. Maybe those make cancellation timing less artificial.
lines.zh: 真实响应样本我来准备，能让取消时机不那么人为。

lines.en: Use controlled scheduling in the tests. Real-time sleeps make concurrency tests unreliable.
lines.zh: 测试用可控调度，实际睡眠会让并发测试不稳定。

lines.en: Okay, I'll inject the scheduler for tests. Production behavior doesn't need a new timing policy.
lines.zh: 好，测试注入调度器，生产不必引入新时间策略。

lines.en: Let's take it offline after the standup. We can inspect the test harness together.
lines.zh: 站会后单独聊，一起检查测试框架。

lines.en: Good, today's commitment should remain small enough. Don't turn pairing into a framework rewrite.
lines.zh: 好，今天承诺规模别太大，结对不变成重写框架。

lines.en: I'll review the seam for scheduler injection. Keep it narrow and internal to testing.
lines.zh: 我审查调度器注入点，保持小范围测试用途。

lines.en: I'll join for the first sample walkthrough. Then I'll return to the contract request.
lines.zh: 我参加首个样例讲解，之后回去处理契约请求。

dialogues.scene: 接口问题明确，Raj请求协助检查游标与取消测试。

dialogues.title: 让未阻塞任务继续走
dialogues.premise: 结对安排已定，把本地测试与外部契约验收拆开跟踪。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别可独立完成的任务和仍不能合并的集成。

lines.en: Make cancellation tests an independent work item. The API contract remains a separate dependency.
lines.zh: 取消测试单独成任务，接口契约仍是另一项依赖。

lines.en: Does the parser change require that contract? Avoid merging behavior based on guessed semantics.
lines.zh: 解析器变更依赖契约吗？不能基于猜测语义合并。

lines.en: Only the integration adapter needs confirmed semantics. Just to confirm, parser review can proceed, right?
lines.zh: 只有集成适配器需要确认语义，确认一下，解析器评审可继续，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, I'll isolate adapter assumptions in fixtures. Maybe the final response changes one test.
lines.zh: 是，我把适配器假设放fixture里，最终回复可能改变一个测试。

lines.en: Keep contract tests unapproved until confirmation. Passing local fixtures doesn't certify the real endpoint.
lines.zh: 确认前不批准契约测试，本地fixture通过不证明真实接口正确。

lines.en: The parser stays up for review today. Its task includes malformed inputs and resource cleanup.
lines.zh: 解析器今天继续待评审，任务含异常输入与资源释放。

lines.en: The performance benchmark is another separate item. It shouldn't delay functional feedback on parsing.
lines.zh: 性能基准单独列项，不拖延解析功能反馈。

lines.en: Okay, give each action item one owner. Let's park that optional export benchmark for later.
lines.zh: 好，每项任务一个负责人，可选导出基准先放下。

lines.en: I'll attach acceptance evidence to each task. That makes partial completion visible without exaggeration.
lines.zh: 每项任务附验收证据，让部分完成可见但不夸大。

lines.en: Good, the board will show integration waiting. We can finish local work without hiding it.
lines.zh: 好，看板显示集成等待，完成本地工作也不遮住依赖。

dialogues.scene: 结对安排已定，把本地测试与外部契约验收拆开跟踪。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 承诺交证据不是承诺一切完成
dialogues.premise: 任务已拆开，逐人确认今日可交付成果。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别具体承诺、估计时间和依赖条件。

lines.en: We'll use an end-of-day checkpoint today. Just to recap, local testing can proceed independently.
lines.zh: 今天设日终检查点，小结一下，本地测试能独立推进。

lines.en: My commitment is initial review feedback. The review queue won't imply automatic approval.
lines.zh: 我承诺给初次评审反馈，排队评审不意味着自动通过。

lines.en: I'm on it for cancellation and cursor tests. Just to confirm, evidence by five, right?
lines.zh: 我负责取消与游标测试，确认一下，五点前交证据，对吧？

lines.en: I'll obtain the owner's contract response today. If it slips, I'll report the dependency.
lines.zh: 今天争取拿到契约回复，若延期就报告依赖。

lines.en: I'll provide the boundary-test review results. A failing case stays visible until repaired.
lines.zh: 我交边界测试评审结果，失败用例修好前持续可见。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for the demo fixture? Maybe we need a fallback presentation.
lines.zh: 好，演示fixture预计什么时候好？可能需备用演示方案。

lines.en: A fixture demo is fine if labelled. Don't present it as completed live integration.
lines.zh: 明确标注的话fixture演示可以，不能冒充真实集成完成。

lines.en: The fixture demo will be ready by four. I'll include the visible integration limitation.
lines.zh: fixture演示四点前就绪，会显示集成限制。

lines.en: We'll review the acceptance checklist at five. Missing evidence means incomplete, not presumed success.
lines.zh: 五点审验收清单，缺证据就未完成，不能假定成功。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll update the board before then. No deployment decision belongs in today's standup.
lines.zh: 同意，之前更新看板，今天站会不做部署决策。

dialogues.scene: 任务已拆开，逐人确认今日可交付成果。
