dialogues.title: 只邀请需要的人深入讨论
dialogues.premise: 今日承诺确定，安排取消测试与契约问题的短讨论。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清会后参与者、议题和结束条件。

lines.en: The follow-up slot starts after this standup. We have a twenty-minute hard stop there.
lines.zh: 站会后开始跟进讨论，二十分钟到点结束。

lines.en: Raj and I will pair on it. Cancellation scheduling is the first concrete topic.
lines.zh: Raj和我结对，第一个具体议题是取消调度。

lines.en: Okay, let's take it offline as agreed. We'll need the sanitized samples there itself.
lines.zh: 好，按约定会后单聊，当场就需要脱敏样本。

lines.en: I'll bring those and join the opening. Maybe ten minutes, then back to integration.
lines.zh: 我带样本参加开头，可能十分钟，之后回去集成。

lines.en: I don't need the full test discussion. Tag me if the interface design changes.
lines.zh: 我不必全程参加测试讨论，接口设计变化再通知我。

lines.en: Good, each new action item gets recorded. The end-of-day checkpoint stays at five.
lines.zh: 好，新增任务逐项记录，日终检查仍在五点。

lines.en: Our output is a deterministic failing test. Not a new architecture proposal this morning.
lines.zh: 产出是确定性失败测试，不是今天上午提新架构。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll bring the current minimal harness. We can demonstrate cancellation without live API access.
lines.zh: 同意，我带最小测试框架，不访问真实接口也能展示取消。

lines.en: I'll start review at eleven as promised. Keep the standup notes linked to tasks.
lines.zh: 按承诺十一点评审，站会记录关联任务。

lines.en: Then I'll send the contract questions now. Everyone has today's next step and owner.
lines.zh: 那我现在发契约问题，大家都明确今天下一步和负责人。

dialogues.scene: 今日承诺确定，安排取消测试与契约问题的短讨论。
dialogues.dir: coding/0195-只邀请需要的人深入讨论
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 先记录今天的行为
dialogues.premise: 迭代计划会开场，团队查看旧脚本与最近修改记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出为何重构前需要测试旧行为。

lines.en: We need a characterization test before extraction. Last week's formatting change altered column order.
lines.zh: 提取代码前需要现有行为测试，上周格式修改改变了列顺序。

lines.en: Did a consumer depend on that order? Behavior includes interfaces, not just calculation results.
lines.zh: 有使用方依赖列顺序吗？行为包括接口，不只是计算结果。

lines.en: Yes, a downstream import reads positional columns. Just to confirm, that order stays unchanged, right?
lines.zh: 是，下游按列位置导入，确认一下，列顺序不变，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, our working hypothesis is tangled responsibilities. One action item is capturing current outputs.
lines.zh: 好，目前假设是职责混杂，一项任务是固定当前输出。

lines.en: Capture representative inputs and failure behavior too. Successful output snapshots aren't enough alone.
lines.zh: 也记录代表性输入和失败行为，只存成功输出快照不够。

lines.en: Maybe the parser also relies on globals. We can't rule that out without inspection.
lines.zh: 解析器可能也依赖全局状态，不检查不能排除。

lines.en: Existing bugs shouldn't become invisible requirements. Label known defects separately from intentional behavior.
lines.zh: 不能把现有缺陷悄悄当需求，已知缺陷与预期行为分开标。

lines.en: A report redesign can wait another iteration. Let's park that while we map behavior.
lines.zh: 报表重设计可以等下轮，梳理行为期间先放下。

lines.en: Keep this review tied to recent changes. We don't need a complete historical rewrite.
lines.zh: 回顾聚焦近期修改，不需要重写全部历史。

lines.en: I'll bring sanitized examples from both consumers. That gives us evidence for scope decisions.
lines.zh: 我带两个使用方的脱敏样本，为范围决策提供证据。

dialogues.scene: 迭代计划会开场，团队查看旧脚本与最近修改记录。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 用修改成本说明耦合
dialogues.premise: 现有行为边界已明确，团队收集维护痛点，不先选框架。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别真正的耦合证据和不属于本轮的问题。

lines.en: There's hidden coupling through the global client. Testing formatting currently requires a network connection.
lines.zh: 全局客户端造成隐藏耦合，测格式化目前还需要联网。

lines.en: That's a concrete reason to separate boundaries. Which changes have the highest recurring cost?
lines.zh: 这是拆边界的具体理由，哪些修改反复成本最高？

lines.en: Filtering changes touch fetching and rendering together. Just to confirm, separating those helps, right?
lines.zh: 筛选修改会同时碰取数和渲染，确认一下，拆开会有帮助，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, our bandwidth covers two engineers this sprint. Maybe three days go to test discovery.
lines.zh: 好，本迭代只有两名工程师投入，测试梳理可能花三天。

lines.en: A characterization test will expose those dependencies. Use injected test clients instead of real calls.
lines.zh: 现有行为测试能暴露这些依赖，用注入测试客户端，不发真实请求。

lines.en: One action item is removing import-time requests. Importing the module shouldn't start a job.
lines.zh: 一项任务是移除导入时请求，导入模块不应启动作业。

lines.en: Good, but keep credential handling unchanged externally. Internal separation doesn't authorize a security redesign.
lines.zh: 好，但外部凭据处理保持不变，内部拆分不代表授权安全重设计。

lines.en: Let's take it offline for framework comparisons. First agree on the behavior we must preserve.
lines.zh: 框架对比会后聊，先同意必须保留的行为。

lines.en: We'll measure isolated test runtime as evidence. Faster tests are useful, not the sole goal.
lines.zh: 记录隔离测试耗时，测试更快有用但不是唯一目标。

lines.en: Agreed, unchanged reports matter more to consumers. I'll collect the command-line invocation examples today.
lines.zh: 同意，使用方更重视报表不变，今天收集命令行调用样例。

dialogues.scene: 现有行为边界已明确，团队收集维护痛点，不先选框架。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 本轮不添加新报表
dialogues.premise: 痛点集中于全局状态与职责混杂，确定两周重构范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出纳入范围、明确排除和需要单独审批的事项。

lines.en: Let's avoid scope creep in this iteration. Preserve CLI arguments, report format, and scheduling.
lines.zh: 本迭代避免范围膨胀，保留命令行参数、报表格式和调度。

lines.en: Does the scope include replacing HTTP libraries? That would introduce unrelated compatibility risk.
lines.zh: 范围含换HTTP库吗？那会增加无关兼容风险。

lines.en: No, just separate pure transformations from fetching. Just to confirm, dependency upgrades stay out, right?
lines.zh: 不，只拆纯转换与取数，确认一下，依赖升级不做，对吧？

lines.en: The managed configuration also keeps its schema. Maybe we can document it without changing fields.
lines.zh: 受管配置也保留结构，可能补文档但不改字段。

lines.en: Removing hidden coupling still needs interface tests. Existing invocations should retain their exit behavior.
lines.zh: 移除隐藏耦合仍需接口测试，现有调用退出行为应保持。

lines.en: Okay, one action item records excluded features. New JSON export belongs in another proposal.
lines.zh: 好，记录排除功能，新JSON导出另提需求。

lines.en: Production rollout needs a separate change approval. This planning agreement doesn't authorize replacing jobs.
lines.zh: 生产上线另需变更审批，计划达成一致不授权替换作业。

lines.en: Let's park that release date until tests exist. We can estimate implementation before scheduling deployment.
lines.zh: 有测试再谈发布日期，可以先估实现，再安排部署。

lines.en: Keep the original runnable artifact available. Comparison and rollback both depend on preserving it.
lines.zh: 保留原来可运行制品，对照与回退都依赖它。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll record consumer compatibility requirements today. They become our boundary for accepting changes.
lines.zh: 同意，今天记录使用方兼容要求，作为接受变更的边界。

dialogues.scene: 痛点集中于全局状态与职责混杂，确定两周重构范围。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 点数不是天数保证
dialogues.premise: 范围确定，团队按不确定性与工作量估算任务。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出估点、实际容量与可选目标的区别。

lines.en: Finishing every extraction is a stretch here. I'd estimate the first slice at five points.
lines.zh: 全部提取完成有挑战，第一个切片估五点。

lines.en: What uncertainty does that estimate include? Points aren't a promise of five days.
lines.zh: 估算含什么不确定性？五点不等于承诺五天。

lines.en: Consumer fixtures still need clarification from owners. Just to confirm, discovery is included, right?
lines.zh: 使用方fixture还需负责人澄清，确认一下，包含梳理时间，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, available bandwidth is lower than usual. What's the ETA for the first fixture set?
lines.zh: 是，可用人力比平时少，首批fixture预计何时好？

lines.en: About two days if consumer samples arrive. The characterization test needs expected failures too.
lines.zh: 收到使用方样本的话约两天，现有行为测试也需预期失败。

lines.en: Maybe five points understates those error paths. I'll separate discovery from mechanical function extraction.
lines.zh: 五点可能低估异常路径，把梳理与机械提函数拆开。

lines.en: Make unknowns explicit before committing capacity. Otherwise estimates hide risk rather than communicate it.
lines.zh: 承诺前明确未知项，否则估算是在藏风险，不是说明风险。

lines.en: Okay, don't solve scope creep by overtime. Optional logging cleanup can remain uncommitted this sprint.
lines.zh: 好，不能靠加班解决范围膨胀，可选日志整理本轮不承诺。

lines.en: The committed goal should be demonstrable behavior. Count test evidence, not just extracted functions.
lines.zh: 承诺目标应是可演示行为，看测试证据，不只数提取函数。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll bring samples by tomorrow morning. Then we can revisit the uncertain estimate.
lines.zh: 同意，明早带样本，然后重新看不确定的估算。

dialogues.scene: 范围确定，团队按不确定性与工作量估算任务。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 允许异议改变承诺
dialogues.premise: 初估五点，Lukas指出隐藏状态与回退验证可能遗漏。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂质疑估算的依据而不是人身否定。

lines.en: Can I challenge that estimate a little? Shared state makes extraction less mechanical here.
lines.zh: 我能稍微质疑估算吗？共享状态让提取没那么机械。

lines.en: Fair, I counted functions rather than behavior. The hidden coupling probably adds integration work.
lines.zh: 有道理，我数了函数没看行为，隐藏耦合可能增加集成工作。

lines.en: The rollback trigger also needs rehearsal evidence. That's work, even without immediate production release.
lines.zh: 回退触发也需预演证据，即使不立刻生产发布也有工作量。

lines.en: Let me play that back for everyone. The full extraction is a stretch, not committed.
lines.zh: 我复述一下，完整提取是挑战目标，不是承诺。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the first slice stays useful, right? Consumers can validate one complete report.
lines.zh: 确认一下，首个切片仍有价值，对吧？使用方能验证一份完整报表。

lines.en: Yes, I can narrow the committed output. Maybe one report path plus its failure cases.
lines.zh: 是，可以缩小承诺产出，可能一个报表路径加失败用例。

lines.en: That sounds clearer than inflating every estimate. Keep optional work separate from the goal.
lines.zh: 比把每项估算都放大更清晰，可选工作与目标分开。

lines.en: Okay, we'll record the revised commitment explicitly. Nobody needs to defend the original number.
lines.zh: 好，明确记录修改后的承诺，不必维护原数字。

lines.en: I'll check that reduced scope remains testable. Smaller doesn't mean skipping the error paths.
lines.zh: 我检查缩小后仍可测试，小范围不等于跳过错误路径。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll confirm it with the consumers. Their acceptance matters more than our point total.
lines.zh: 同意，我与使用方确认，验收比总点数更重要。

dialogues.scene: 初估五点，Lukas指出隐藏状态与回退验证可能遗漏。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 第一切片贯通输入输出
dialogues.premise: 承诺缩小，拆成行为基线、一个报表切片和后续可选工作。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分贯通切片与只做某一层的横向拆分。

lines.en: The first vertical slice covers daily reporting. Input parsing, transformation, and output work together.
lines.zh: 首个贯通切片覆盖日报，输入解析、转换、输出连起来。

lines.en: That's better than extracting every helper first. We can validate an actual consumer workflow.
lines.zh: 比先提取所有辅助函数好，可以验证真实使用流程。

lines.en: Just to confirm, baseline tests come first, right? Then Raj can be heads-down on extraction.
lines.zh: 确认一下，基线测试先做，对吧？之后Raj专注提取。

lines.en: I'm on it with the sanitized fixtures. Maybe the failure samples need an extra day.
lines.zh: 脱敏fixture我来做，失败样本可能额外需要一天。

lines.en: A characterization test runs before each extraction. Afterward it compares the same input outputs.
lines.zh: 每次提取前跑行为测试，之后对比同一输入输出。

lines.en: I'll keep the existing CLI entry point. Internal modules won't change the scheduled invocation.
lines.zh: 保留原CLI入口，内部模块不改变调度调用。

lines.en: Use small reviewable changes with passing tests. A giant final merge raises comparison risk.
lines.zh: 小改动、可评审、测试通过，大量最终合并增加对照风险。

lines.en: One action item is defining each review boundary. Raj implements, Lukas reviews, Hannah verifies behavior.
lines.zh: 一项任务是明确每次评审边界，Raj实现、Lukas评审、Hannah验证。

lines.en: The second report remains optional this iteration. Its tests mustn't silently replace first-slice acceptance.
lines.zh: 第二份报表本轮可选，其测试不能悄悄替代首个切片验收。

lines.en: Good, consumers will see a complete example. That makes feedback useful before broader extraction.
lines.zh: 好，使用方能看到完整例子，扩大提取前反馈更有用。

dialogues.scene: 承诺缩小，拆成行为基线、一个报表切片和后续可选工作。

dialogues.title: 用行为证据验收
dialogues.premise: 计划会收尾，确定第一切片的验收与未来发布保护。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出验收不只看测试绿灯，还看兼容和回退证据。

lines.en: Our acceptance criteria include identical approved reports. Documented exit codes and arguments stay compatible.
lines.zh: 验收标准包括批准报表一致，已记录退出码和参数兼容。

lines.en: We'll dry-run it first against fixed fixtures. Then compare isolated execution with the old artifact.
lines.zh: 先用固定fixture预演，再把隔离执行与旧制品比较。

lines.en: Keep volatile timestamps normalized in comparison. Don't mask meaningful differences such as row ordering.
lines.zh: 对比中规范易变时间戳，但不能掩盖行顺序等有意义差异。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the vertical slice needs review, right? Passing tests alone won't approve production.
lines.zh: 确认一下，贯通切片需评审，对吧？测试通过不单独授权生产。

lines.en: Yes, I'll sign off consumer output compatibility. Maybe weekly report fixtures need separate acceptance later.
lines.zh: 是，我验收使用方输出兼容，周报fixture以后可能单独验收。

lines.en: The smoke test must include missing configuration. It should fail safely without partial published reports.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试包括配置缺失，应安全失败，不发布半份报表。

lines.en: A mismatch is our future rollback trigger. Stop the new job before restoring old scheduling.
lines.zh: 不一致是将来回退触发，恢复旧调度前先停新作业。

lines.en: Okay, no overlapping writers during any switch. I'll retain the old artifact and configuration.
lines.zh: 好，切换不能重叠写入，保留旧制品和配置。

lines.en: Let's record those gates in the plan. Mid-iteration review will check evidence against them.
lines.zh: 把关卡写入计划，中期检查按它们查看证据。

lines.en: Agreed, the plan is ready to start. We'll reconvene next Wednesday with actual progress.
lines.zh: 同意，计划可开始执行，下周三带实际进度再开会。

dialogues.scene: 计划会收尾，确定第一切片的验收与未来发布保护。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 中期不偷加导出功能
dialogues.premise: 一周后的中期检查：首个切片已提取，销售新增导出需求，异常样本仍待补齐。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出新增需求如何影响承诺以及团队选择。

lines.en: Would the export request change the commitment? We're halfway through the agreed two-week iteration.
lines.zh: 导出需求会改变承诺吗？两周迭代已到中途。

lines.en: Yes, it's a new external interface. Adding it now would be scope creep.
lines.zh: 会，这是新的外部接口，现在加入属于范围膨胀。

lines.en: The extraction works on the approved fixtures. Just to confirm, exports aren't acceptance criteria, right?
lines.zh: 提取在批准fixture上可用，确认一下，导出不属验收标准，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, I'll explain that to the requester. Maybe next iteration after the current review.
lines.zh: 对，我向需求方说明，可能本轮评审后放下一轮。

lines.en: Two malformed input fixtures are still missing. We can't call the original slice done yet.
lines.zh: 还缺两个异常输入fixture，原切片不能算完成。

lines.en: Okay, let's park that new export request. What's the ETA for the missing samples?
lines.zh: 好，新导出先放下，缺失样本预计何时到？

lines.en: The consumer owner promised them tomorrow morning. Meanwhile we can review resource cleanup independently.
lines.zh: 使用方负责人说明早给，目前可独立评审资源释放。

lines.en: I underestimated discovery, not the extraction itself. I'll update remaining work without hiding the delay.
lines.zh: 低估的是梳理，不是提取本身，我更新剩余工作并明确延期。

lines.en: Keep the original gates unless explicitly renegotiated. A deadline doesn't automatically waive missing evidence.
lines.zh: 除非明确重新协商，否则保持原关卡，到期限不自动免证据。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll chase the samples this afternoon. We still protect the original consumer contract.
lines.zh: 同意，下午催样本，仍保护原使用方契约。

dialogues.scene: 一周后的中期检查：首个切片已提取，销售新增导出需求，异常样本仍待补齐。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 完成证据与未完成项分开说
dialogues.premise: 两周迭代结束：首个日报切片已按约定样本验收，扩展异常数据测试未全部完成，尚未生产发布。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清实际完成、遗留任务及不能宣称的结果。

lines.en: Just to recap, the first slice passed. Additional malformed-data tests will carry over separately.
lines.zh: 小结：首个切片通过，额外异常数据测试单独转下轮。

lines.en: The agreed acceptance criteria are met. The extra cases extend coverage beyond those fixtures.
lines.zh: 约定验收标准已满足，额外用例扩展此前fixture之外的覆盖。

lines.en: Full extraction was a stretch, as expected. Just to confirm, no production release yet, right?
lines.zh: 完整提取如预期只是挑战目标，确认一下，尚未生产发布，对吧？

lines.en: Right, consumer sign-off covers isolated report comparisons. Operational release still needs its own approval.
lines.zh: 对，使用方验收仅针对隔离报表对比，运行上线另需批准。

lines.en: What made review easier this iteration? We should preserve the practices that actually helped.
lines.zh: 本轮什么让评审更容易？保留真正有效的实践。

lines.en: Small changes and fixed fixtures helped most. Maybe discovery deserves an earlier owner next time.
lines.zh: 小改动和固定fixture最有帮助，下次梳理可能应更早指定负责人。

lines.en: Agreed, waiting for samples delayed meaningful feedback. We shouldn't blame implementation for every delay.
lines.zh: 同意，等样本延迟了有效反馈，不能把所有延期归到实现。

lines.en: One action item is tracking sample dependencies. We'll compare waiting time in the next iteration.
lines.zh: 一项任务是跟踪样本依赖，下轮比较等待时长。

lines.en: Faster local tests are a useful result. They don't prove production reliability has improved yet.
lines.zh: 本地测试更快是有用结果，但还不能证明生产可靠性提高。

lines.en: Good distinction, I'll keep that in the summary. Today's evidence supports maintainability, not outage reduction.
lines.zh: 区分得对，总结保留，今天证据支持可维护性，不证明故障减少。

dialogues.scene: 两周迭代结束：首个日报切片已按约定样本验收，扩展异常数据测试未全部完成，尚未生产发布。

dialogues.title: 完成标准先约定再执行
dialogues.premise: 回顾确认第一切片结果，下一轮优先补额外异常测试，再考虑周报与部署。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别改进责任、下轮优先级和发布仍需的审批。

lines.en: Let's refine our definition of done together. Evidence links should be ready before review.
lines.zh: 共同完善完成标准，评审前准备好证据链接。

lines.en: Include consumer sign-off and rollback rehearsal. Keep implementation completion separate from production deployment.
lines.zh: 包含使用方验收和回退预演，实现完成与生产部署分开。

lines.en: The carry over tests get priority next sprint. Maybe we'll postpone the second report slice.
lines.zh: 转下轮的测试优先，第二个报表切片可能延后。

lines.en: Every characterization test needs approved expected behavior. The consumer owner confirms unusual cases, right?
lines.zh: 每个行为测试需批准预期，使用方负责人确认特殊用例，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, and known defects stay labelled. Fixing one requires explicit updated acceptance criteria.
lines.zh: 是，已知缺陷保留标注，修复需明确更新验收标准。

lines.en: Okay, sample ownership is our first action item. Anika will obtain examples before sprint planning.
lines.zh: 好，样本负责人是第一项任务，Anika计划会前拿例子。

lines.en: I'll review the release proposal after testing. Scope changes need approval, not retrospective justification.
lines.zh: 测试后审发布申请，改范围需审批，不能事后找理由。

lines.en: I'll close the loop on boundary tests. The optional export request remains outside this plan.
lines.zh: 我把边界测试闭环，可选导出仍不在本计划。

lines.en: We'll inspect waiting time at next retro. One iteration won't establish a lasting trend.
lines.zh: 下次回顾看等待时长，一个迭代不能确立长期趋势。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll share today's decisions with consumers. They know what changed and what didn't.
lines.zh: 同意，分享今天决定，让使用方知道改变与未改变的部分。

dialogues.scene: 回顾确认第一切片结果，下一轮优先补额外异常测试，再考虑周报与部署。

dialogues.title: 先问清更新语义
dialogues.premise: 面试开场，题目要求Python处理排队资产标签更新。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住候选人的澄清问题与面试者给出的范围。

lines.en: Design a Python worker for tag updates. What would you clarify before writing code?
lines.zh: 设计处理标签更新的Python worker，写代码前会澄清什么？

lines.en: I'll walk you through my questions first. Just to confirm, updates replace tags, right?
lines.zh: 我先逐步说我的问题，确认一下，是替换标签，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, the message contains the desired set. Assume a durable queue and authenticated API.
lines.zh: 是，消息包含目标标签集合，假定有持久队列和已认证API。

lines.en: Okay, let me play that back carefully. We apply desired state, not append repeated changes.
lines.zh: 好，我认真复述，是应用目标状态，不是重复追加变更。

lines.en: My working hypothesis is duplicate delivery matters. Maybe requests can time out after succeeding.
lines.zh: 我首先假设重复投递很重要，请求可能成功后才超时。

lines.en: Both happen in this exercise regularly. What would you exclude from the first implementation?
lines.zh: 本题两种情况都常发生，初版会排除什么？

lines.en: I'd exclude scheduling and authentication system design. Those are provided, so let's park that.
lines.zh: 排除调度和认证系统设计，它们已给定，先放下。

lines.en: And what needs an explicit contract? Don't rely on unstated service behavior here.
lines.zh: 什么需要明确契约？不能依赖未声明服务行为。

lines.en: I'd check update ordering and deduplication support. One action item is understanding acknowledgement semantics.
lines.zh: 检查更新顺序和去重支持，一个需确认事项是消息确认语义。

lines.en: Then I'd sketch the simplest safe flow. Code comes after those constraints are clear.
lines.zh: 约束明确后画最简单安全流程，再写代码。

dialogues.scene: 面试开场，题目要求Python处理排队资产标签更新。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 大小、顺序和有效期
dialogues.premise: 明确替换目标状态，面试者给出大小和顺序约束。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出候选人如何防止超大输入与旧状态覆盖。

lines.en: Messages can arrive out of order. Each includes an asset version and operation identifier.
lines.zh: 消息可能乱序，每条含资产版本和操作标识。

lines.en: I'd require bounded input for tag counts. Just to confirm, the API checks versions, right?
lines.zh: 标签数量要有输入上限，确认一下，API检查版本，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, stale versions return a conflict. There's also a documented maximum request size.
lines.zh: 是，旧版本返回冲突，也有最大请求大小文档。

lines.en: Okay, let me play that back briefly. Local validation checks shape before sending a request.
lines.zh: 好，简短复述，本地先验结构，再发请求。

lines.en: The server remains authoritative for version checks. My working hypothesis is concurrent writers still exist.
lines.zh: 版本检查以服务端为准，我假设仍存在并发写入者。

lines.en: They do, outside this worker too. How would you handle a rejected old version?
lines.zh: 存在，worker外也有写入者，旧版本被拒如何处理？

lines.en: I'd record a conflict without blind retry. Maybe business logic decides whether to refresh intent.
lines.zh: 记录冲突，不盲重试，是否刷新意图由业务逻辑决定。

lines.en: Good, don't invent a new desired state. The worker shouldn't silently override another writer.
lines.zh: 好，不能凭空造新目标状态，worker不应悄悄覆盖其他写入者。

lines.en: We can rule that out with conditional writes. But an outdated message still needs explicit handling.
lines.zh: 条件写可防止覆盖，但过期消息仍需显式处理。

lines.en: One action item is documenting that conflict policy. I'd keep validation separate from transport code.
lines.zh: 需记录冲突策略，输入验证与传输代码分开。

dialogues.scene: 明确替换目标状态，面试者给出大小和顺序约束。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 先画一条完整处理路径
dialogues.premise: 输入有上限，服务端支持版本检查，候选人提出初始流程。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解持久状态、租约和消息确认的先后。

lines.en: Show the worker's processing flow now. Where do you place durable state and acknowledgements?
lines.zh: 现在展示处理流程，持久状态与消息确认放哪里？

lines.en: I'd start with a small worker pool. Each task validates bounded input first. Then it acquires work through a lease.
lines.zh: 先用小worker池，每项任务先验有限输入，再通过租约取得处理权。

lines.en: What do you persist before sending? Memory-only bookkeeping disappears when the worker crashes.
lines.zh: 发送前持久化什么？只在内存记账会随崩溃丢失。

lines.en: The operation identifier and payload hash persist first. Just to confirm, identifiers survive redelivery, right?
lines.zh: 先持久化操作标识和负载哈希，确认一下，重投标识不变，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, then lease work and send it. Terminal results persist before acknowledging the queue message.
lines.zh: 好，之后租约取任务并发送，确认消息前持久化终态结果。

lines.en: What if acknowledgement fails after success? That creates the duplicate processing window we're discussing.
lines.zh: 成功后消息确认失败呢？这就是正在讨论的重复处理窗口。

lines.en: I'm on it by checking persisted terminal state. Maybe redelivery only needs another acknowledgement then.
lines.zh: 我通过查持久终态处理，重投时可能只需重新确认消息。

lines.en: Can you demonstrate the flow safely? We don't want real infrastructure changes in interviews.
lines.zh: 能安全演示流程吗？面试不希望改真实基础设施。

lines.en: I'd dry-run it first with a fake client. Then run isolated integration tests against a sandbox.
lines.zh: 先用假客户端预演，再对沙箱做隔离集成测试。

lines.en: One action item covers durable state. I'd define each transition explicitly. The lease alone doesn't guarantee unique effects.
lines.zh: 需定义持久状态及每个显式转换，租约本身不保证副作用唯一。

dialogues.dir: coding/0208-先画一条完整处理路径

dialogues.title: 键要稳定且对应同一负载
dialogues.premise: 流程包含发送前持久记录，面试追问重复请求副作用。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清API幂等契约的边界与相同键不同负载的处理。

lines.en: Suppose the request succeeds but response disappears. How do you avoid applying it twice?
lines.zh: 请求成功但响应丢失，如何避免应用两次？

lines.en: I'd reuse the persisted idempotency key exactly. Just to confirm, the server deduplicates atomically, right?
lines.zh: 原样复用持久化幂等键，确认一下，服务端原子去重，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, for the same key and payload. Its retention period is twenty-four hours.
lines.zh: 是，限相同键和负载，保留期二十四小时。

lines.en: Okay, let me play that back clearly. Deduplication is guaranteed only inside that retention period.
lines.zh: 好，清楚复述，去重只在保留期内保证。

lines.en: My working hypothesis is retries stay inside it. One action item sets a shorter retry deadline.
lines.zh: 我假设重试在该期限内，需设更短重试截止时间。

lines.en: What if a duplicate identifier changes payload? Would you reuse the same key anyway?
lines.zh: 同标识重投但负载变化呢？还用同一个键吗？

lines.en: No, I'd reject the mismatched payload hash. That indicates invalid input or a producer bug.
lines.zh: 不，拒绝负载哈希不符，说明输入错误或生产者缺陷。

lines.en: And if two workers acquire overlapping leases? Don't claim the lease makes this impossible.
lines.zh: 两个worker取得重叠租约呢？不能说租约让它不可能。

lines.en: Server deduplication handles overlapping identical requests here. We can rule that out as repeated effects.
lines.zh: 此处服务端去重处理重叠相同请求，能排除重复副作用。

lines.en: Maybe both workers still consume resources briefly. I'd also use atomic claims to reduce overlap.
lines.zh: 两个worker仍可能短暂消耗资源，也用原子取任务减少重叠。

dialogues.scene: 流程包含发送前持久记录，面试追问重复请求副作用。
dialogues.dir: coding/0209-键要稳定且对应同一负载
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 超时不是确定失败
dialogues.premise: API提供有限期幂等去重，继续讨论瞬态失败与重试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解退避、随机抖动、截止时间及结果查询。

lines.en: How would you handle timeouts and throttling? Give the retry limits, not just a loop.
lines.zh: 如何处理超时与限流？说明重试边界，不只是循环。

lines.en: I'd retry with backoff and random jitter. Reuse the idempotency key and unchanged payload.
lines.zh: 采用退避和随机抖动重试，复用幂等键和原负载。

lines.en: What limits would bound that retry policy? Remember the server's finite deduplication retention.
lines.zh: 什么限制重试策略？记住服务端去重有保留期限。

lines.en: Okay, set attempts and an overall deadline. Just to confirm, throttling supplies Retry-After, right?
lines.zh: 好，设次数和总截止时间，确认一下，限流提供Retry-After，对吧？

lines.en: I'd honor it within the remaining deadline. Maybe a result query resolves ambiguous timeouts faster.
lines.zh: 在剩余期限内遵守，结果查询可能更快解决不确定超时。

lines.en: The API supports querying by operation identifier. What if that query is unavailable too?
lines.zh: API支持按操作标识查询，如果查询也不可用呢？

lines.en: I'd keep an eye on unresolved operations. At the deadline, persist unknown rather than failed.
lines.zh: 持续关注未决操作，到截止时间存为结果未知，不是确定失败。

lines.en: A caller asks, what's the ETA now? Would you promise completion from the retry schedule?
lines.zh: 调用方问预计何时完成，会根据重试计划承诺完成吗？

lines.en: No, I'd report the next planned attempt. That's an estimate, not guaranteed completion or success.
lines.zh: 不会，只报下一次计划尝试时间，是估计，不保证完成或成功。

lines.en: Let's park that operation for reconciliation afterward. Never issue a fresh key to bypass uncertainty.
lines.zh: 之后把该操作留待核对，绝不发新键绕过不确定性。

dialogues.scene: API提供有限期幂等去重，继续讨论瞬态失败与重试。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 永久错误与未知结果分开
dialogues.premise: 重试已有限制，面试追问不可重试错误和结果未知的状态。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别无效输入、权限问题、版本冲突与超时。

lines.en: Which errors count as a permanent failure? Would every non-success response enter that category?
lines.zh: 哪些算永久失败？所有非成功响应都归这类吗？

lines.en: No, invalid inputs fail without unchanged retry. Just to confirm, authentication errors need intervention, right?
lines.zh: 不，非法输入不原样重试，确认一下，认证错误需干预，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, distinguish permission denial from token expiry. The provided client can refresh expired tokens.
lines.zh: 对，区分权限拒绝和令牌过期，给定客户端可刷新过期令牌。

lines.en: Okay, one action item documents each category. The escalation path names whoever handles authorization failures.
lines.zh: 好，需记录各类别，升级路径说明谁处理授权失败。

lines.en: My working hypothesis is malformed responses are unknown. Maybe the write happened before response corruption.
lines.zh: 我认为响应损坏应属未知，写入可能在响应损坏前发生。

lines.en: How do you debug without leaking credentials? An exception trace can contain request details.
lines.zh: 如何调试又不泄凭据？异常栈可能含请求详情。

lines.en: Let me tail the log with sanitized fixtures. I'd retain operation identifiers, not bearer tokens.
lines.zh: 用脱敏fixture检查日志，保留操作标识，不保留访问令牌。

lines.en: What happens when the worker is cancelled? You may have an active remote request.
lines.zh: worker被取消怎么办？可能有活动远程请求。

lines.en: I'd stop claiming work and close local resources. Active requests remain unknown until their outcomes reconcile.
lines.zh: 停止取新任务，释放本地资源，活动请求核对前保留未知状态。

lines.en: Then expired leases allow another worker to recover. It checks durable state before repeating any request.
lines.zh: 租约过期后另一worker接管，重复请求前检查持久状态。

dialogues.scene: 重试已有限制，面试追问不可重试错误和结果未知的状态。
dialogues.dir: coding/0211-永久错误与未知结果分开
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 把崩溃窗口测出来
dialogues.premise: 状态分类完成，候选人解释如何证明幂等与恢复逻辑。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别发送、结果落盘与消息确认之间的故障窗口。

lines.en: Describe your tests for crash recovery. Which failure windows would you deliberately exercise?
lines.zh: 描述崩溃恢复测试，会特意覆盖哪些故障窗口？

lines.en: I'd use fault injection around each transition. Just to confirm, we can simulate lost responses, right?
lines.zh: 各状态转换附近做故障注入，确认一下，可模拟响应丢失，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, include success before local persistence. Then crash before queue acknowledgement as well.
lines.zh: 可以，包括成功后本地落盘前，再测确认消息前崩溃。

lines.en: Okay, each restart reads the persisted operation. Tests assert one applied effect, not one request.
lines.zh: 好，重启读持久操作，断言副作用一次，不是请求一次。

lines.en: I'd dry-run it first with deterministic fakes. Maybe property tests help explore duplicate message sequences.
lines.zh: 先用确定性假实现预演，属性测试可能有助探索重复消息序列。

lines.en: How do you test concurrent workers? A sequential duplicate test won't expose claim races.
lines.zh: 如何测并发worker？顺序重复测试发现不了取任务竞态。

lines.en: I'd coordinate contenders with a controlled barrier. We can rule that out only after racing claims.
lines.zh: 用受控屏障协调竞争者，实际竞争取任务后才可排除问题。

lines.en: Would you also test the real contract? Fake deduplication could be stronger than production behavior.
lines.zh: 也测真实契约吗？假去重可能比生产行为更强。

lines.en: Yes, a sandbox smoke test checks deduplication. One action item covers retention expiry and payload mismatch.
lines.zh: 是，沙箱冒烟测试验证去重，保留期结束和负载冲突也列测试任务。

lines.en: I'd also test stale versions and oversized input. Those cases must avoid sending unsafe updates.
lines.zh: 还测旧版本和超大输入，这些情况不能发送不安全更新。

dialogues.scene: 状态分类完成，候选人解释如何证明幂等与恢复逻辑。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 吞吐受哪个瓶颈限制
dialogues.premise: 正确性测试方案已说明，面试者提高吞吐需求。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出并发上限、队列背压与测量先于优化。

lines.en: Now assume ten thousand queued updates. How would you increase throughput without overloading dependencies?
lines.zh: 现在有一万条待更新，如何提高吞吐又不压垮依赖？

lines.en: I'd use bounded concurrency in the worker pool. Just to confirm, the API publishes limits, right?
lines.zh: worker池采用有限并发，确认一下，API公布限额，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, requests and active connections are limited. Does your queue also stay in memory?
lines.zh: 是，请求和活动连接均有限，队列也全放内存吗？

lines.en: No, I'd fetch a limited batch size. That preserves memory headroom and avoids unbounded buffering.
lines.zh: 不，每次取有限批量，保留内存余量，避免无限缓冲。

lines.en: Okay, my working hypothesis is network waiting dominates. Maybe profiling shows serialization matters more instead.
lines.zh: 好，初步假设网络等待占主导，也可能剖析后发现序列化更重要。

lines.en: What would you measure before choosing async? Concurrency isn't always the same as throughput.
lines.zh: 选异步前测什么？并发不总等于吞吐。

lines.en: I'd measure queue age and request latency. Keep an eye on throttling and retry amplification.
lines.zh: 测排队年龄和请求延迟，关注限流与重试放大。

lines.en: How would you keep retries fair? New work could starve older unresolved operations.
lines.zh: 如何让重试公平？新任务可能让旧未决操作饥饿。

lines.en: I'd schedule due retries with bounded shares. They shouldn't monopolize workers or disappear behind newcomers.
lines.zh: 到期重试分配有限份额，不独占worker，也不被新任务淹没。

lines.en: Then benchmark representative payloads under sandbox limits. I'd tune from evidence, not thread-count guesses.
lines.zh: 在沙箱限额下用代表性负载压测，按证据调，不猜线程数。

dialogues.scene: 正确性测试方案已说明，面试者提高吞吐需求。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 不声称端到端恰好一次
dialogues.premise: 吞吐方案有上限，面试者追问跨系统一致性和复杂度取舍。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分投递保证、副作用幂等与不确定结果核对。

lines.en: Would you describe this as exactly-once processing? Explain the guarantee without hiding its limits.
lines.zh: 会称为恰好一次处理吗？解释保证，不隐藏限制。

lines.en: No, our queue provides at-least-once delivery. The idempotency key limits duplicate remote side effects.
lines.zh: 不会，队列至少一次投递，幂等键限制重复远程副作用。

lines.en: But the local ledger isn't remotely atomic. What remains uncertain after a long outage?
lines.zh: 本地记录与远端不是原子事务，长故障后还有什么不确定？

lines.en: Unknown results may outlive the deduplication period. Just to confirm, blind resubmission is unsafe, right?
lines.zh: 未知结果可能超过去重期限，确认一下，盲重发不安全，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, a temporary workaround pauses those operations. One action item is authoritative result reconciliation.
lines.zh: 好，临时措施是暂停这些操作，需核对权威结果。

lines.en: Would adding another database solve that gap? Or does it merely move the uncertainty?
lines.zh: 再加数据库能解决缺口吗？还是只移动不确定性？

lines.en: It won't create a cross-system transaction automatically. Maybe stronger service contracts are needed for guarantees.
lines.zh: 不会自动建立跨系统事务，更强保证可能需要加强服务契约。

lines.en: What complexity would you defer initially? We still want a maintainable first solution.
lines.zh: 初版推迟什么复杂度？仍希望首版可维护。

lines.en: Let's park that custom distributed transaction coordinator. I'd prefer the provided contract and explicit reconciliation.
lines.zh: 先放下自建分布式事务协调器，优先给定契约和显式核对。

lines.en: The trade-off is visible operational follow-up work. I'd document that rather than promise impossible semantics.
lines.zh: 代价是需要明确运维跟进，会记录它，不承诺不可能语义。

dialogues.scene: 吞吐方案有上限，面试者追问跨系统一致性和复杂度取舍。
dialogues.dir: coding/0214-不声称端到端恰好一次
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 询问团队怎样支持安全交付
dialogues.premise: 技术讨论结束，面试者邀请候选人反问工程流程与入职支持。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出候选人的真正问题和面试者的实际回答。

lines.en: We've covered the technical exercise now. What questions do you have about our team?
lines.zh: 技术题已讨论完，你对团队有什么问题？

lines.en: How does engineering onboarding cover unsafe operations? Just to confirm, new engineers get sandbox access, right?
lines.zh: 入职培训如何覆盖危险操作？确认一下，新人有沙箱访问，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, with a mentor and scoped permissions. Production changes need review and explicit approval.
lines.zh: 有，配导师和限定权限，生产变更需评审与明确审批。

lines.en: Mentors walk you through approvals, right? Sorry, I mean the production review process.
lines.zh: 导师会带新人了解审批，对吧？抱歉，我具体指生产变更评审流程。

lines.en: How much bandwidth do mentors usually reserve? Maybe pairing early prevents repeated safety mistakes.
lines.zh: 导师通常留多少时间？早期结对可能防止反复安全失误。

lines.en: We reserve pairing time during initial weeks. Small changes get feedback before larger independent work.
lines.zh: 最初几周预留结对时间，先小改动获反馈，再独立做大任务。

lines.en: How do you close the loop on incidents? Does each action item get an owner?
lines.zh: 事件改进如何闭环？每个行动项都有负责人吗？

lines.en: Yes, owners provide evidence at follow-up reviews. We track completion, not just ticket creation.
lines.zh: 有，负责人在跟进评审提供证据，跟踪完成，不只建工单。

lines.en: That helps me understand your engineering expectations. I'd also ask how testing time gets protected.
lines.zh: 这样更理解团队工程要求，还想问如何保障测试时间。

lines.en: Thanks, those answers address my main concerns. I'd enjoy learning within those clear safety boundaries.
lines.zh: 谢谢，回答了我的主要问题，希望在明确安全边界内学习。

dialogues.scene: 技术讨论结束，面试者邀请候选人反问工程流程与入职支持。

dialogues.title: 切换停住：不要直接提升
dialogues.premise: 账本写入超时，控制器没有提升备机。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别客户端超时和主机死亡并非同一证据。

lines.en: Failover didn't kick in. No, it started, then stopped. The error rate spiked.
lines.zh: 故障切换没自动启动。不，准确说是启动后停住了。错误率陡涨。

lines.en: Is the old primary actually dead?
lines.zh: 旧主真的已经停机了吗？

lines.en: I'll take point on this. No promotion yet.
lines.zh: 我来主抓。暂时不提升备机。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. Writes are paused.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志。写入已暂停。

lines.en: Paused where? Direct clients could bypass that.
lines.zh: 在哪层暂停？直连客户端可能绕过去。

lines.en: Just to confirm, both entry paths, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，两条入口都暂停了，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, gateway and batch writers are blocked.
lines.zh: 是的，网关和批处理写入都被阻止了。

lines.en: Okay, that doesn't prove the host's stopped.
lines.zh: 好，但这不能证明主机已经停止。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is lost cluster connectivity.
lines.zh: 当前假设是集群连接丢失。

lines.en: Maybe. Keep host state separate from symptoms.
lines.zh: 可能。把主机状态与故障现象分开看。

dialogues.scene: 账本写入超时，控制器没有提升备机。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 提交点：已确认写入在哪里
dialogues.premise: 写入口已冻结，需要检查备机角色和持久化状态。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂同步确认语义，而非仅看复制延迟。

lines.en: The last committed position matches our witness.
lines.zh: 最后提交位置与见证记录一致。

lines.en: Does that include every acknowledged client write?
lines.zh: 这包括所有已向客户端确认的写入吗？

lines.en: Yes, acknowledgments require durable synchronous replication here.
lines.zh: 是的，这里确认写入要求同步复制持久化。

lines.en: Was synchronous mode enabled throughout this incident?
lines.zh: 整个故障期间都启用了同步模式吗？

lines.en: Just to confirm, no asynchronous fallback, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，没有退到异步模式，对吧？

lines.en: That's our working hypothesis. The audit looks reassuring.
lines.zh: 这是当前假设。审计结果看起来令人放心。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Verify replay too.
lines.zh: 我复述一下。还要验证日志回放。

lines.en: Replay reached that position. We'll keep an eye on later records.
lines.zh: 回放已到该位置。我们会留意后续记录。

lines.en: Good, but divergence remains possible until isolation.
lines.zh: 好，但隔离前仍有分叉可能。

lines.en: We can't rule that out yet. Isolation next.
lines.zh: 还不能排除。接下来检查隔离。

dialogues.scene: 写入口已冻结，需要检查备机角色和持久化状态。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 探测失败：不等于旧主死亡
dialogues.premise: 备机提交点已核对，但旧主仍不可从集群网络访问。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分网络路径失效和主机电源状态。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is a network partition.
lines.zh: 当前假设是网络分区。

lines.en: What evidence separates that from host failure?
lines.zh: 有什么证据能区分它和主机故障？

lines.en: The out-of-band console responds. That's independent connectivity.
lines.zh: 带外控制台有响应，那是独立连接。

lines.en: Console access alone doesn't prove database activity.
lines.zh: 仅能访问控制台不能证明数据库仍在运行。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. Local write attempts appear.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志，里面有本地写入尝试。

lines.en: Scheduled jobs, perhaps. They bypass our gateway.
lines.zh: 也许是定时任务，它们绕过网关。

lines.en: Then the gateway block isn't complete fencing.
lines.zh: 那网关阻断就不算完整的隔离。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no promotion now, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，现在不提升，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Preserve logs before disabling the host.
lines.zh: 对，禁用主机前先保留日志。

lines.en: We can rule that out as total power loss.
lines.zh: 可以排除完全断电这一解释。

dialogues.scene: 备机提交点已核对，但旧主仍不可从集群网络访问。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 先锁住：路由不是隔离
dialogues.premise: 旧主仍可能执行本地任务，不能仅靠切换路由。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住防双写措施与不充分的网络隔离。

lines.en: Let's freeze changes. Split brain is the risk.
lines.zh: 冻结变更。风险是双主脑裂。

lines.en: Changing DNS won't stop local database writers.
lines.zh: 改DNS不会停止数据库本地写入者。

lines.en: The network partition leaves old sessions uncertain.
lines.zh: 网络分区使旧会话状态不明。

lines.en: And network filters might miss another interface.
lines.zh: 网络过滤也可能漏掉另一个网卡。

lines.en: That's our blast radius: conflicting order records.
lines.zh: 影响范围就是产生冲突的订单记录。

lines.en: Just to confirm, power fencing first, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，先做电源隔离，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, with independent confirmation and restart inhibition.
lines.zh: 是的，需独立确认并禁止自动重启。

lines.en: The escalation path reaches our infrastructure operator.
lines.zh: 升级联系路径可联系基础设施操作员。

lines.en: Could automated recovery turn it back on?
lines.zh: 自动恢复会不会把它重新打开？

lines.en: Possibly. We'll disable that before any promotion.
lines.zh: 有可能。提升前我们会先禁用它。

dialogues.scene: 旧主仍可能执行本地任务，不能仅靠切换路由。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 有条件批准：还不是开始提升
dialogues.premise: 已选择独立管理平面电源隔离，讨论提升条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出条件批准与实际执行批准的差别。

lines.en: The promotion gate needs two verified checks.
lines.zh: 提升门槛需要两项已验证检查。

lines.en: Old primary fenced, and acknowledged data replayed.
lines.zh: 旧主已隔离，已确认数据已回放。

lines.en: The last committed position is replayed already.
lines.zh: 最后提交位置已经回放完成。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger after promotion starts?
lines.zh: 提升开始后，什么情况触发回退？

lines.en: Pause new writes. Don't reactivate the old primary.
lines.zh: 暂停新写入，不要重新启用旧主。

lines.en: Go/no-go stays pending isolation evidence itself.
lines.zh: 继续或停止的决策仍要等隔离证据本身。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Approval is conditional.
lines.zh: 我复述一下：批准是有条件的。

lines.en: What's the ETA for power confirmation? Roughly?
lines.zh: 电源确认预计多久？大概呢？

lines.en: About three minutes. Verify the correct host identifier.
lines.zh: 大约三分钟，要核对正确主机标识。

lines.en: Okay, I'll record both approvals before proceeding.
lines.zh: 好，我会在继续前记录两项批准。

dialogues.scene: 已选择独立管理平面电源隔离，讨论提升条件。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 电源证据：隔离成功才提升
dialogues.premise: 基础设施操作员按批准流程关闭旧主并锁定重启。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分API请求被接受和最终关闭已确认。

lines.en: I'm on it. We'll fence off ledger-one.
lines.zh: 我来操作，可靠隔离ledger-one。

lines.en: The request was accepted. Is shutdown complete?
lines.zh: 请求已受理，关闭完成了吗？

lines.en: Now confirmed off through the out-of-band console.
lines.zh: 现在带外控制台已确认关闭。

lines.en: I independently checked power and restart inhibition.
lines.zh: 我独立核对了电源状态和重启禁止。

lines.en: Just to confirm, lock persists, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，锁定会持续生效，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, the automation exclusion is recorded too.
lines.zh: 是的，自动化排除配置也已记录。

lines.en: Okay, the promotion gate can now pass.
lines.zh: 好，现在提升门槛可以通过了。

lines.en: Standby promoted. A local smoke test passed.
lines.zh: 备机已提升，本地关键功能快速验证通过。

lines.en: Perhaps enough for a canary, not full traffic.
lines.zh: 也许足够开始灰度，但还不能全量接流量。

lines.en: Agreed. Keep application writers paused until routing validation.
lines.zh: 同意。路由验证前继续暂停应用写入。

dialogues.scene: 基础设施操作员按批准流程关闭旧主并锁定重启。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 写端点：旧连接也要检查
dialogues.premise: 新主本地验证通过，准备恢复少量应用写入。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂连接池更新与幂等重试的要求。

lines.en: The writer endpoint now resolves to ledger-two.
lines.zh: 写入端点现在解析到ledger-two。

lines.en: Did existing connection pools refresh their targets?
lines.zh: 现有连接池更新目标了吗？

lines.en: Yes, controlled reconnects. No blind request replay.
lines.zh: 是的，受控重连，没有盲目重放请求。

lines.en: Use idempotency keys for any uncertain retry.
lines.zh: 所有结果未知的重试都要用幂等键。

lines.en: Just to confirm, staged rollout, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，是分阶段恢复，对吧？

lines.en: One tenant first. The smoke test passed.
lines.zh: 先一个租户，关键功能快速验证通过了。

lines.en: Okay, compare accepted requests against durable orders.
lines.zh: 好，把已受理请求与持久化订单对照。

lines.en: We'll keep an eye on queue age.
lines.zh: 我们会留意队列等待时间。

lines.en: Maybe slower draining will buy us time.
lines.zh: 也许慢一些处理积压能争取核对时间。

lines.en: Yes, expand only while those checks remain clean.
lines.zh: 是的，只有这些检查持续正常才扩大范围。

dialogues.scene: 新主本地验证通过，准备恢复少量应用写入。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 未知提交：先查订单再重试
dialogues.premise: 灰度写入正常，部分超时请求的最终结果仍未知。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分已确认、未确认和可安全重试的提交。

lines.en: Uncertain commits need lookup by idempotency key.
lines.zh: 结果未知的提交需要按幂等键查询。

lines.en: We've matched all acknowledged requests to orders.
lines.zh: 所有已确认请求都匹配到了订单。

lines.en: What about writes without a client acknowledgment?
lines.zh: 没有向客户端确认的写入呢？

lines.en: Some committed before disconnect. That's expected, right?
lines.zh: 有些断连前已经提交，这是可能的，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. A timeout doesn't mean transaction failure.
lines.zh: 是的，超时不等于事务失败。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Look up first.
lines.zh: 我复述一下：先查结果。

lines.en: The last committed position supports acknowledged-write coverage.
lines.zh: 最后提交位置支持已确认写入的覆盖核验。

lines.en: But don't rule that out for unacknowledged gaps.
lines.zh: 但未确认写入中的缺口仍不能排除。

lines.en: Just to recap, retries can catch up safely.
lines.zh: 小结一下，重试可以安全补齐。

lines.en: With deduplication, yes. Perhaps manual review for exceptions.
lines.zh: 有去重机制才行。异常也许需要人工核查。

dialogues.scene: 灰度写入正常，部分超时请求的最终结果仍未知。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 旧主不能直接回来
dialogues.premise: 业务恢复基线，旧主仍关机锁定；准备观察与后续重建。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂新写入后不能把旧主直接作为回退目标。

lines.en: We're back to baseline. Queue age recovered.
lines.zh: 恢复基线了，队列等待时间也正常了。

lines.en: Can the old host rejoin as a replica?
lines.zh: 旧主机可以作为副本重新加入吗？

lines.en: After rebuilding from the authoritative primary only.
lines.zh: 只能在从权威新主重建之后加入。

lines.en: Preserve its divergent records before rebuilding anything.
lines.zh: 重建任何内容前，先保留它的分叉记录。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no immediate failback, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，不立即切回，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. New writes make that unsafe now.
lines.zh: 对，新写入使直接切回已不安全。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation. Include reconciliation failures.
lines.zh: 继续观察，也要看核对失败。

lines.en: Uncertain commits are resolved, except two disputed requests.
lines.zh: 未知提交已处理完，只剩两条有争议的请求。

lines.en: Those need business review, probably not automatic replay.
lines.zh: 那些需要业务核查，大概不适合自动重放。

lines.en: We'll hand over those cases with named owners.
lines.zh: 我们会把这些案例交给明确的负责人。

dialogues.scene: 业务恢复基线，旧主仍关机锁定；准备观察与后续重建。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 修权限：安全停住并不是坏事
dialogues.premise: 服务稳定，调查控制器未能完成旧主隔离的原因。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分安全拒绝提升与故障切换功能修复验收。

lines.en: Fencing credentials expired. The provider rejected shutdown.
lines.zh: 隔离凭据过期，提供方拒绝了关闭操作。

lines.en: So refusing promotion protected us from dual writers.
lines.zh: 所以拒绝提升保护了我们，避免双写。

lines.en: Yes, but the root cause is still open.
lines.zh: 是的，但根因仍未查明。

lines.en: You mean why expiry escaped monitoring?
lines.zh: 你指为什么过期没被监控发现？

lines.en: Exactly. Rotation itself worked; controller refresh didn't.
lines.zh: 正是。凭据轮换本身执行了，但控制器没有刷新凭据。

lines.en: An action item: test rejection handling too.
lines.zh: 一个待办项：也测试隔离被拒绝的处理。

lines.en: Dry-run it first, then isolate a test cluster.
lines.zh: 先试运行，再隔离一套测试集群。

lines.en: Verify we can fence off before promotion.
lines.zh: 验证提升前能够可靠隔离。

lines.en: Maybe include restart attempts and missing permissions.
lines.zh: 也许还应包含重启尝试和权限缺失测试。

lines.en: Okay, I'll close the loop with recorded safety evidence.
lines.zh: 好，我会带着记录的安全证据完成反馈。

dialogues.scene: 服务稳定，调查控制器未能完成旧主隔离的原因。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 预测不是已测容量
dialogues.premise: 促销今晚开始，需先核对预计流量与数据库承载能力。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分预测值、压测值和安全工作点。

lines.en: Our peak forecast is six thousand requests.
lines.zh: 预测峰值是每秒六千个请求。

lines.en: Per second? What's the expected request mix?
lines.zh: 每秒吗？预计的请求构成是什么？

lines.en: Yes. Browsing dominates, but checkout bursts matter.
lines.zh: 是的，浏览居多，但结账突发也重要。

lines.en: Our database test used a different mix.
lines.zh: 数据库测试用的是另一种请求构成。

lines.en: We may need to shed load early.
lines.zh: 可能要提前减轻承接负载。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no enforcement yet, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，还没执行拦截，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. The working hypothesis needs representative testing.
lines.zh: 对，当前假设需要有代表性的测试。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for replay analysis today.
lines.zh: 今天我有精力做流量回放分析。

lines.en: Okay, include expensive writes and callback bursts.
lines.zh: 好，要包含高成本写入和回调突发。

lines.en: What's the ETA? Roughly before lunch?
lines.zh: 预计多久？大概午饭前能完成吗？

dialogues.scene: 促销今晚开始，需先核对预计流量与数据库承载能力。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 关键请求不是全部免限流
dialogues.premise: 回放确认数据库成本差异，需要对业务路径分级。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出关键业务预留资源与无限豁免的区别。

lines.en: Our critical path includes orders and payment callbacks.
lines.zh: 关键业务路径包括订单和支付回调。

lines.en: Are callbacks authenticated before getting priority?
lines.zh: 回调获得优先级前是否经过认证？

lines.en: Yes, provider signatures. Headers alone aren't trusted.
lines.zh: 是的，要校验提供方签名，不能只信请求头。

lines.en: Which requests can we shed load from?
lines.zh: 可以从哪些请求上减轻承接负载？

lines.en: Recommendations and exports. Checkout confirmation stays protected.
lines.zh: 推荐和导出可以降级，结账确认保持保护。

lines.en: Just to confirm, protected isn't unlimited, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，受保护不代表无限制，对吧？

lines.en: Let me play that back. Separate bounded pools.
lines.zh: 我复述一下：分开的、有上限的资源池。

lines.en: That's our blast radius if shared storage overloads.
lines.zh: 共享存储过载会影响到这些业务。

lines.en: Maybe callbacks need buffering, not immediate rejection.
lines.zh: 也许回调需要缓冲，而不是立即拒绝。

lines.en: Okay, use the peak forecast for each class.
lines.zh: 好，按每个业务类别使用峰值预测。

dialogues.scene: 回放确认数据库成本差异，需要对业务路径分级。
dialogues.dir: ha/0227-关键请求不是全部免限流
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 配额：算业务成本，不只数请求
dialogues.premise: 已划分关键与可降级业务，设计桶容量和全局上限。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出单租户、公平性和数据库总成本三个限制层。

lines.en: The rate limit uses weighted token buckets.
lines.zh: 速率限制使用加权令牌桶。

lines.en: Weighted by measured database cost, or guesswork?
lines.zh: 权重依据实测数据库成本，还是猜测？

lines.en: Measured samples. Our working hypothesis still needs validation.
lines.zh: 依据实测样本，但当前假设仍需验证。

lines.en: How much burst allowance can memory absorb?
lines.zh: 内存能承受多少突发余量？

lines.en: Memory headroom supports two seconds of callbacks.
lines.zh: 内存余量可支持两秒的回调缓冲。

lines.en: Just to confirm, queues stay bounded, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，队列会有上限，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. Bound concurrency on the critical path too.
lines.zh: 是的，关键业务路径的并发也要有上限。

lines.en: A global ceiling protects shared database capacity.
lines.zh: 全局上限保护共享数据库容量。

lines.en: Okay, a smoke test won't establish that ceiling.
lines.zh: 好，快速功能验证不能确定这个上限。

lines.en: Agreed. Roughly twenty percent spare, pending load tests.
lines.zh: 同意，暂定约百分之二十余量，待压测确认。

dialogues.scene: 已划分关键与可降级业务，设计桶容量和全局上限。
dialogues.accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）

dialogues.title: 降级后也不能误报支付成功
dialogues.premise: 阈值初稿完成，产品评审可见的降级行为与重试语义。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别推荐回退、支付结果未知和业务成功。

lines.en: Graceful degradation removes recommendations, not order confirmation.
lines.zh: 有控制的降级移除推荐，不移除订单确认。

lines.en: What does the customer see during payment uncertainty?
lines.zh: 支付结果不明时，客户会看到什么？

lines.en: Pending status. Never a fabricated success message.
lines.zh: 显示处理中，绝不虚构成功消息。

lines.en: Does cached content remain tenant-safe and fresh?
lines.zh: 缓存内容是否保持租户隔离和适当时效？

lines.en: Public recommendations only. Personalized responses aren't shared.
lines.zh: 只缓存公共推荐，不共享个性化响应。

lines.en: Just to confirm, critical path intact, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，关键业务路径保持完整，对吧？

lines.en: Maybe. Test confirmation when recommendations are unavailable.
lines.zh: 也许。测试推荐不可用时的订单确认。

lines.en: That'll buy us time without hiding payment errors.
lines.zh: 这能争取时间，又不掩盖支付错误。

lines.en: Okay, define the rollback trigger using business outcomes.
lines.zh: 好，用业务结果定义回退触发条件。

lines.en: New recommendation designs? Let's park that today.
lines.zh: 新的推荐设计？今天先暂存这个话题。

dialogues.scene: 阈值初稿完成，产品评审可见的降级行为与重试语义。

dialogues.title: 影子数据先行，灰度范围有限
dialogues.premise: 降级行为通过功能验证，先记录拟拦截再选择灰度。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分影子命中率和真实业务影响。

lines.en: Shadow mode records decisions without rejecting requests.
lines.zh: 影子模式记录决策，但不拒绝请求。

lines.en: Does that show actual client retry behavior?
lines.zh: 这能显示真实客户端重试行为吗？

lines.en: No, only predicted rejections. Enforcement tests come next.
lines.zh: 不能，只能显示预计拦截，执行测试在后面。

lines.en: Okay, compare eligible requests by business class.
lines.zh: 好，按业务类别对比符合条件的请求。

lines.en: Just to confirm, staged rollout follows review, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，评审后才分阶段发布，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. The rate limit initially covers recommendations.
lines.zh: 是的，速率限制最初只覆盖推荐。

lines.en: A smoke test passed for fallback content.
lines.zh: 回退内容的关键功能快速验证通过了。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on checkout completion too.
lines.zh: 我也会留意结账完成率。

lines.en: Perhaps shared-IP shoppers need closer inspection first.
lines.zh: 也许得先仔细检查共享IP的购物者。

lines.en: Agreed. Review that cohort before enabling rejection.
lines.zh: 同意，启用拒绝前先评审这类用户。

dialogues.scene: 降级行为通过功能验证，先记录拟拦截再选择灰度。
